textos.20x. A evolucao final. O DM a chama de F: 20x. The final evolution. The DM calls it Black Form.
22x to 44x. Also reachable from Golden Oozaru.
textos.22x. O ki divino sobre a forma BASE -- c: 22x. God Ki on top of the BASE form -- red hair and aura.
textos.22x. O ki divino sobre a forma base. O c: 22x. God Ki on top of the base form. A stolen body can reach godhood too.
textos.250.000 zeni de campanha (cobrados ao ve: 250,000 zeni for the campaign (charged when you pass the trial)
textos.2x, subindo de 2x em 2x até 16x com a ma: 2x, climbing 2x at a time up to 16x with mastery -- which rises very slowly and is capped by your base power: up to 6x at Super Saiyan level, up to 10x at Super Saiyan 2 level, and only near Super Saiyan 3 does it reach 100% (16x). Your body stays your own; the aura turns pink and sparks crackle across your skin.
textos.2x. O pico da propria especie. Pede a sk: 2x. The peak of your own species. Requires the Alien Transformation skill and one million base power.
textos.32x, o patamar do Super Saiyajin Blue. A: 32x, the level of Super Saiyan Blue. The tension of a Human who has awakened God Ki -- and it's in this form that they mature it.
textos.32x. O Blue de quem tem o ki divino corr: 32x. The Blue of those whose God Ki is corrupted -- pink instead of blue.
textos.32x. Super Saiyajin com o ki divino aces: 32x. Super Saiyan with God Ki ignited. Unlocks at 33% divine mastery.
textos.3x fixo. O primeiro degrau da linhagem p: A flat 3x. The first step of the primal bloodline.
textos.4x. O segundo e ultimo degrau da especie: 4x. The species' second and final stage -- ten million base power.
textos.50.000 zeni: a armadura do computador so: 50,000 zeni: raises the computer's armor to 1.2x your tech cap
textos.56x -- o mesmo poder do Beast. Nao se tr: 56x -- the same power as Beast. It can't be trained: it's the extra the dragon grants a Namekian who wishes to unlock their own potential. The skin turns orange and the body grows.
textos.56x subindo até 76x, cada vez mais depre: 56x climbing to 76x, faster and faster. Sanity is gone: the body fights on its own, screams like an animal and Ki drains away for good -- until they black out and fall asleep.
textos.56x. Grade 2 com o ki divino aceso. Elit: 56x. Grade 2 with God Ki ignited. Elite, 50% divine mastery.
textos.56x. O Prodigial nao vira deus: ele vira: 56x. A Prodigial doesn't become a god: they become a BEAST. Triggered by anger.
textos.56x. O degrau final do ki divino corromp: 56x. The final step of corrupted God Ki.
textos.56x. O poder cru do Corrupted Majin, sem: 56x. The raw power of the Corrupted Majin, with nothing borrowed: this is their body now. Only absorbing someone brings them out of it -- and living in it wears down their sanity.
textos.5x, e o tanque de Ki DOBRA. Desperta per: 5x, and your Ki pool DOUBLES. It awakens near the same power at which a Saiyan becomes a Super Saiyan -- and the exact point is YOURS, not the game's.
textos.60x. A aura da Destruicao: quanto mais a: 60x. The aura of Destruction: the more you get hit, the stronger you get.
textos.60x. O corpo se move sem a mente. Esquiv: 60x. The body moves without the mind. Dodges on its own.
textos.66x. O ego que se alimenta da propria do: 66x. The ego that feeds on its own pain.
textos.66x. O instinto completo: cabelo pratead: 66x. Instinct perfected: silver hair, and no attack lands.
textos.6x, e até 12x com a maestria. A tensão v: 6x, up to 12x with mastery. The tension goes to the extreme: the body endures what no Human should. Unlocks around where Super Saiyan 2 does.
textos.72x. A furia do Deus da Destruicao: so d: 72x. The fury of the God of Destruction: only for whoever holds the title, and it's lost along with it.
textos.75.000 zeni, uma vez: o computador refaz: 75,000 zeni, one-time: when the android who encrypted the computer dies, the computer rebuilds them right beside it
textos.8s parado e sem levar dano frustram a in: 8s standing still without taking damage foils someone else's invasion
textos.: ela aparece no corpo quando você os ve: : it shows on your body when you put them on.
textos.; o dinheiro acabou no meio ({0} por blo: ; the money ran out partway ({0} per block)
textos.; {0} não couberam (o terreno, uma máqui: ; {0} didn't fit (terrain, a machine or someone in the way)
textos.A AMEACA DOS ANDROIDES ACABOU! A Terra e: THE ANDROID THREAT IS OVER! Earth is finally free.
textos.A Bola de Ki carregada: o dobro da poten: The charged Ki Ball: twice the potency, with power twenty percent greater than yours behind it. In return it costs five times as much and locks your next shot for two seconds.
textos.A Estrela Makyo, que só se aproxima da T: The Makyo Star, which only comes near Earth once every five thousand years.
textos.A Estátua do Dragão de {0} vira pó com o: The Dragon Statue of {0} crumbles to dust with the planet, and the seven Dragon Balls with it.
textos.A FURIA LENDARIA TOMA O SEU CORPO. Voce: THE LEGENDARY FURY TAKES OVER YOUR BODY. You no longer control what it does.
textos.A GRAVIDADE ESTÁ ESMAGANDO SEU CORPO! Vo: THE GRAVITY IS CRUSHING YOUR BODY! You can barely crawl. Get out of here NOW or it won't hold out.
textos.A Onda Selante. Precisa de um Pote Selan: The Evil Containment Wave. It needs a Sealing Jar set down nearby: the wave goes after the target and seals them in the jar forever. It costs 90 damage to EACH of your limbs -- it can kill you. Anyone who wants the prisoner back has to break the jar.
textos.A SUA SANIDADE ACABOU. A Forma Pura INSA: YOUR SANITY IS GONE. The INSANE Pure Form takes over your body -- you no longer control what it does.
textos.A Terra não existe mais -- esta saída fe: Earth no longer exists -- this way out is closed.
textos.A Tri-Bomba: uma esfera pesada paga com: The Kikoho (Tri-Beam): a heavy sphere paid for with your OWN LIFE, not just energy. Each consecutive use shouts a syllable (KI, KO, HO) and comes out stronger than the last -- and takes more blood. Three in a row can knock you down.
textos.A arte e a cor do seu ki, e a mesa das t: Your ki's look and color, plus the workbench for the techniques you invent: beam, ball or homing, with {0} points each. It's the original game's Create Attack / Customize Attack.
textos.A batalha contra {0} começou em {1}! Der: The battle against {0} has begun on {1}! Defeat him before he loses his patience (~{2} min).
textos.A camera vai pra luta de agora (e volta: Moves the camera to the current fight (and back when you press it again). Same as the button in the bottom-left corner.
textos.A carta está centrada na NAVE (em {0}, c: The chart is centered on the SHIP (in {0}, hull {1}%), not on you. It goes back to showing you once you disembark.
The harvest was good this year.
textos.A concentracao total da aura: forca fisi: Your aura at full concentration: physical strength, Ki offense and speed all rise together. Costs energy per second, and the cost DROPS as you practice. It shuts off on its own when your energy nears its end.
textos.A cor do ponto e a classe da estrela, me: A dot's color is its star's class, measured from the star's own art. Zoom in and the worlds appear: from afar as a dot (orange has its own map, gray-blue is generated), up close as the world's art, the same you see from space, with an orange ring on the ones with their own map. Double-click a WORLD to travel.
textos.A disputa pela Super Esfera #{0} fracass: The claim on Super Dragon Ball #{0} has failed.
textos.A dona do palácio no meio do Caminho da: The mistress of the palace halfway along Snake Way. She loves visitors -- and hates it when they leave.
textos.A energia de {0} varre {1}... e ninguém: {0}'s energy sweeps across {1}... and no one could stop him.
textos.A energia que {0} juntava sobre {1} SE D: The energy {0} was gathering over {1} HAS DISSIPATED!
textos.A escola que forma protetores. Molda cas: The school that trains protectors. Crafts training shells of up to 10,000 kg, and uses and teaches the Kamehameha.
textos.A escola rival. Não forma santos -- form: The rival school. It doesn't train saints -- it trains efficient assassins.
textos.A esquiva do gato: preso num agarrao, vo: The cat's escape: caught in a grab, you try to slip free with a flip. Your chance grows with your offense and power against your captor's strength, and with how much you've already struggled. Escaping hurts whoever was holding you. Costs Ki even if it fails.
textos.A esquiva passa a valer TAMBEM enquanto: Dodging ALSO works while you charge Ki -- charging no longer leaves you exposed.
The statue goes up without it.
textos.A ficha COMPLETA do alvo marcado, sem si: The marked target's FULL sheet, nothing hidden: BP, form, masteries, body, account.
textos.A forma da destruicao: 60x. Entrar renov: The form of destruction: 60x. Entering it restores your energy to 80%.
textos.A forma do instinto desperto: 60x. Entra: The form of awakened instinct: 60x. Entering it restores your accuracy to 80%.
textos.A furtividade do assassino: voce some da: The assassin's stealth: you vanish from sight for a few moments (one second plus a tenth per point of Technique). Costs Ki and puts your special attacks on hold for six seconds. Doesn't work if you're already invisible.
textos.A fúria sem forma. 1,5x, e até 10x com a: Formless fury. 1.5x, up to 10x with mastery; fighting adds up to +20% on top.
The gravity there crushes the weak. If you can't stay on your feet, don't even bother knocking.
textos.A guarda tem {0}% a mais de chance de ce: Your guard is {0}% more likely to break ({1}).
textos.A historia do Bills volta a dormir e os: Beerus's story goes back to sleep and both of them leave wherever they are. If the Buu saga has already been won, he wakes up again on his own. Doesn't touch anyone's title.
textos.A idade, o cargo e a história dessa pess: This person's age, rank and story, as you last saw them.
textos.A ira do Deus transborda! {0} pulsa com: The God's wrath overflows! {0} pulses with redoubled power!
textos.A irma mais cara das Balas Continuas: vi: The pricier sibling of Continuous Energy Bullets: twenty spheres per second forming around you and flying out in ALL eight directions, a little stronger. Eight-second cooldown afterward.
textos.A janela de desejos abre sozinha quando: The wish window opens on its own when the dragon rises. Whoever raised the statue configures the dragon there: his name, the wishes per summoning and the wishes he grants.
textos.A lenda do sangue comum. 25x a 50x -- so: The legend of common blood. 25x to 50x -- only at 100% mastery is it truly whole, and until then it's the fury calling the shots.
textos.A linhagem do futuro: 10 estagios de 2x: The bloodline from the future: 10 stages from 2x to 20x, +2x for every 10% of mastery.
textos.A lista de quem esta no mundo, com a zon: The list of who's in the world, with each one's zone.
textos.A lâmina vira uma espada longa: o mesmo: The blade becomes a longsword: the same bonus as Ki Blade, only more generous, and a bigger bite of energy to summon. It occupies your hand like the blade does, and the two can't coexist.
textos.A maestria divina cresce USANDO o ki div: Divine mastery grows by USING God Ki, in a form that calls for it -- twice as fast in combat. It unlocks the next steps: {0}%, {1}% and {2}%.
textos.A maestria sobe usando: +{0}% a cada Ins: Mastery rises with use: +{0}% per completed Instant Transmission (Yardrat: +{1}%).
textos.A maestria só cresce com o Kaio-ken aces: Mastery only grows with Kaio-ken active -- slowly up to x20, and very slowly after that. Beyond your mastery it costs more Ki, stamina and flesh; going past double your mastery and running out of Ki tears your body apart.
textos.A mesa abre por partes. Ainda falta: {0}: Technique creation unlocks in stages. Still locked: {0}.
textos.A mesma corrida do Movimento Rapido. No: The same dash as Rapid Movement. In the original game it promised to circle around the enemy after arriving, but that promise was never kept: it's the same three-tile advance.
textos.A mesma estrela, outro chão. Qual dos mu: Same star, different ground. Which world you get is the luck of the draw -- a world's gravity is free training, so the game won't let anyone pick which one.
textos.A nave de Freeza pousou! FREEZA esta no: Frieza's ship has landed! FRIEZA is on Planet Vegeta -- if no one stands up to him, he WILL DESTROY the planet!
textos.A nave de Freeza se aproxima do Planeta: Frieza's ship draws closer to Planet Vegeta... Days until arrival: {0}.
textos.A onda da Escola da Tartaruga: o raio qu: The Turtle School's wave: the beam that TRAVELS THE FARTHEST of all and costs the least per second. The better your beam skill, the stronger it comes out -- and the pricier it gets to sustain.
textos.A onda da realeza saiyajin. Irma do Kame: The wave of Saiyan royalty. The Kamehameha's sister, a little stronger and a little slower -- and at peak skill it reaches fifty tiles, farther than any other beam in the game.
textos.A onda de fogo negro dos Namekuseijin. E: The Namekians' black-fire wave. It isn't the strongest, but it carries more power behind the beam than your own body has -- and those who master beam skill double that power.
textos.A orbita e PARADA: a posicao: The orbit is FIXED: its position
textos.A organizacao ENCERRA a luta! Os juizes: The organizers have STOPPED the fight! The judges will decide on points...
textos.A paralisia dos Metamorianos: mais barat: The Metamorans' paralysis: cheaper than Paralysis and with a bit less power behind it, but the same promise -- it can't be deflected, and the legs stop.
textos.A plataforma no centro do interior da Ca: The platform at the center of the Capital Ship's interior. Leaving through it puts you wherever the ship is NOW -- not where you boarded.
textos.A porta da Sala do Tempo. Precisa da aut: The door to the Time Chamber. You need the Earth Guardian's permission, and your body can only take one visit per day.
textos.A presenca maligna fica mais forte a cad: The evil presence grows stronger by the day... Days remaining: {0}.
textos.A procuração de {0} sobre as Super Esfer: {0}'s proxy over the Super Dragon Balls has been broken: {1}.
textos.A pé, Terra→Namek leva {0} min ({1} dias: Under your own power, Earth→Namek takes {0} min ({1} in-game days). In a Spacepod at top speed ({2}x), {3} min.
textos.A que está solta não funciona: aparafuse: A loose one doesn't work: bolt it down (E key next to it, or the Bolt verb).
textos.A raça inicial é sorteada: Alien 22%, Te: The starting race is rolled: Alien 22%, Human 20%, Namekian 18%, Saiyan 15%, Frost Demon 8%, Majin 4%, and the other thirteen races 1% each. A Saiyan's lineage and a Namekian's clan are rolled too; the class (Elite, Legendary...) works the same as always.
textos.A recarga do soco está {0} mais lenta (s: Your punches recharge {0} slower (both arms lost).
textos.A seed do universo, as zonas com gente e: The universe seed, the zones with people in them, and the planets in your chunk.
textos.A tradição de Kami. Faz chaves da Sala d: Kami's tradition. Makes Time Chamber keys and grants entry; a Guardian of the Dragon Clan also creates Dragon Balls.
textos.A transformação do Deus da Destruição: {:
The God of Destruction's transformation: {0}x, with a violet aura clinging to the body. It costs no Ki and has no mastery -- it belongs to the TITLE: it only turns on for whoever holds it, and drops the moment the title is lost.

It can't go on top of another transformation (power that one down first), and while it's up no other can go on. Press again to power down.
textos.A trava de segurança desligou a gravidad: The safety lock shut off the gravity: {0} passed out.
textos.A versao encadeada do Punho da Presa: qu: The chained version of the Wolf Fang Fist: four hits while ADVANCING, each one pushing you onto the target. None of them sends the target flying -- and that's the beauty of it: the target stays in front of you until the last one.
textos.A viagem leva o tempo que diz: o piloto: The trip takes as long as it says: the pilot moves at normal speed, no teleporting. Earth to Namek is 7 in-game days, just like in the anime.
textos.A visita de Bills à Terra terminou. A ca: Beerus's visit to Earth is over. His home is at {{coordenadas}} ({{mundo}}), and everyone's star chart now marks the spot.
textos.A vitrine de {0} está no tier {1} e esta: {0} is unlocked up to tier {1}, and this skill is tier {2}: invest more milestones in that tree ({3} to go; you've invested {5}).
{0} is unlocked up to tier {1}, and this skill is tier {2}: that tree's tier goes up some other way, not with milestones.
textos.A voz do povo de Namek. Guarda 3 Esferas: The voice of Namek's people. Keeps 3 Dragon Balls and appoints the four Elders.
textos.A {0} cai de {1}! Ela está no chão, onde: The {0} falls from {1}! It's lying on the ground where they stood.
textos.A ÚNICA escolha desta tela que mexe em a: The ONLY choice on this screen that affects your stats -- and it's permanent.
textos.ACABOU -- {0} min pra sair pela porta: TIME'S UP -- {0} min to get out the door
textos.ALGUÉM está tomando sua Super Esfera #{0: SOMEONE is taking your Super Dragon Ball #{0}! Cell [{1}:{2}], position ({3}, {4}). You have {5} min.
textos.APAGA as sete esferas deste mundo, para: ERASES this world's seven Dragon Balls, forever. Anyone next to the statue can do it -- and there's no going back.
textos.APAGA quem você está agarrando (ou quem:
ERASES whoever you're grabbing (or whoever is right in front of you). Only works when the target's TORSO is at {0}% or less and they're at least {1}% weaker than you right now.

Anyone erased this way pays King Yemma {2}x the price to come back to life.
textos.AQUI NÃO HÁ O QUE EXTRAIR: a Drill só tr: NOTHING TO EXTRACT HERE: the Drill only works on a planet -- on the surface, or in one of its caves.
textos.ATATATATATA. Custa folego E energia, e d: ATATATATATA. Costs stamina AND energy, and leaves the target unable to react for TEN seconds. Requires being up close with a free hand; your special body attacks go on cooldown afterward.
textos.ATENCAO: no maximo, e com poder alto, a: WARNING: at maximum, with high power, the explosion takes the planet with it -- and you too.
textos.ATENÇÃO: você não consegue nem andar com: WARNING: you can't even walk with this, and you'll lose health as long as you stay like this.
textos.AVISO: o alvo esta caido e o tique vai d: WARNING: the target is down and the tick will undo the form -- heal them first.
textos.AVISO: sem rabo inteiro a fera cai no pr: WARNING: without a whole tail the beast falls apart on the next tick -- heal the target first.
textos.AVISO: {0} também NÃO fala a língua dos: WARNING: {0} does NOT speak the Language of the Gods either -- they won't be able to summon the dragon.
textos.Abaixo de 1,0 o raio morre andando; acim: Below 1.0 the beam fades as it travels; above it, the beam grows stronger. ONE point per 0.1 — the old game's text said 2, but its math was always this. (value × 10)
textos.Abre (ou fecha) o chaveamento na tela: t: Opens (or closes) the bracket on screen: every name, round by round, with your next fight pulsing.
textos.Abre AGORA o Torneio do Outro Mundo -- s: Opens the Other World Tournament RIGHT NOW -- only the dead in the Other World can sign up.
textos.Abre AGORA um Torneio de Artes Marciais: Opens a World Martial Arts Tournament on Earth RIGHT NOW: invitations, sign-ups, NPCs in any leftover slots. The next automatic one is rescheduled starting today.
textos.Abre a fabricação de tecnologia de onde: Opens tech fabrication wherever you are.
textos.Abre a mesa onde você desenha suas própr: Opens the workbench where you design your own techniques: beam, ball or homing, with {0} points to spread across power, charge, energy cost, speed and range. You can keep {1} in your head.
textos.Abre os olhos e volta pro seu corpo -- e: Opens your eyes and brings you back to your body -- exactly as it was when you went in.
textos.Abre os olhos e volta pro seu corpo, com: Open your eyes and return to your body, just as it was when you went in.
textos.Absorve quem está na sua frente. Os DOIS:
Absorbs whoever is in front of you. You BOTH need to be Namekian -- there's no skill to learn and neither one's power matters.

Their power becomes YOURS, for good: you get both BPs added together and doubled, the best stats of the two, their abilities -- and SUPER NAMEKIAN awakens in you.

AND THEIR CHARACTER CEASES TO EXIST, forever. There's no separating, no going back, and not even an administrator can undo it. They have to accept, and will have to confirm twice.

Absorbing a Namekian from the WORLD (an NPC) works too, but yields almost nothing: no stats, no abilities and no transformation.
textos.Acabou o tempo da aula. Volte quando as: Class is over. Come back when your legs stop shaking.
textos.Acalme três almas briguentas: nocauteie: Calm down three rowdy souls: knock out three different souls in the Other World.
textos.Aceita a habilidade que alguem esta te e: Accepts the ability someone is teaching you right now. You need to HAVE the milestones it requires -- but learning doesn't spend any milestones. (The exception is a MASTER'S LESSON: whatever your master wouldn't teach a stranger does spend the milestones, and the offer warns you.)
textos.Aceita a oferta de voltar a ser jovem qu: Accepts the offer to be made young again.
Accepts the title duel right now.
textos.Aceita o assento de Anciao que te oferec: Accepts the Elder seat you were offered.
Accepts the NAMEKIAN fusion invitation. This isn't regular fusion: your character is DELETED forever, and its power goes to whoever invited you.

You don't become a passenger, you don't come back later and you can't be revived. Not even an administrator can undo it.

Your ACCOUNT is still yours: you can create another character in place of this one.

The server will ask for confirmation TWICE, a few seconds apart.
textos.Aceita o convite de fusão que está na su:
Accepts the fusion invitation waiting for you. You become the passenger: whoever invited you drives the body, and you come back when the fusion ends.

DOESN'T work for Namekian fusion -- that one has its own button, because it costs you your character.
textos.Aceita o convite de mestre -- ou o ensin: Accepts the master's invitation -- or the teaching they're offering you right now.
textos.Aceita o convite do torneio em andamento: Accepts the invitation to the ongoing tournament (Earth or Other World). The corner panel does the same.
Accepts the child request from someone who loves you.
textos.Aceita que despertem o seu potencial ado: Lets someone awaken your dormant potential (once in a lifetime).
textos.Aceita ser Aprendiz de Kaioshin de quem: Accepts the offer to become the Kaioshin Apprentice of whoever made it.
textos.Acende o pavio lento deste planeta: 20 m: Lights this planet's slow fuse: 20 minutes in four stages, and then it explodes. The inhabitants start dying off and the ground begins to split open.
textos.Acerta, esquiva, corre e recupera fôlego: You hit, dodge, run and recover stamina more easily. In exchange, a severe cut to strength and physical endurance.
textos.Acima da sua maestria: o Ki, o vigor e o: Above your mastery: Ki, stamina and body wear down {0}x faster.
textos.Acima de 4x do seu limite o corpo não an: Above 4x your limit your body can't move: take off your weights (Equip tab) or get off this ground.
textos.Adia o duelo. O terceiro adiamento na me: Postpones the duel. A third postponement in the same week is cowardice and costs you the title.
textos.Admin: você pode trocar ou tirar o nome: Admin: you can change or remove the name of any planet.
textos.Ah, visitas. Trouxeram alguma coisa pra: Ah, visitors. Did you bring anything to eat?
Not ported to this game yet: {0}.
I still haven't gotten used to this halo.
textos.Ajuste quanto vestir pela mochila (tecla: Set how much to wear in the inventory (I key), as a % of the max weight: every step weighs you down, and in exchange training pays off more. If the gain is at 1x, the weights are too light for your body: upgrade the max weight.
textos.Algo está errado com {0}. O ar ficou pes: Something is wrong with {0}. The air has grown heavy, and the animals have vanished.
textos.Algo instável e maligno apodrece dentro: Something unstable and malevolent festers within you: an offensive power far beyond a common Majin's.
textos.Alto, médio e baixo comparam com a SUA m: High, average and low are compared against YOUR own average: it's aptitude, not power.
textos.Apaga o pavio deste planeta antes do fim: Puts out this planet's fuse before the end. Only works BEFORE the explosion finishes.
textos.Apaga os ataques de ki dos outros a até: Erases other people's ki attacks within {0} tiles that carry LESS power than you have right now. {1}-minute recharge -- and it only starts if something was nullified.
textos.Aparafusa (ou solta) a construcao ao seu: Bolts down (or unbolts) the construction next to you. It won't work unless it's bolted down.
textos.Aparece ao lado do alvo e golpeia, varia: Appears next to the target and strikes, several times in a row -- how many depends on your speed and on how much you've trained the technique. Then comes exhaustion, which lasts twenty times the interval between jumps.
textos.Apareçam na minha casa. Coordenadas galá: Come to my house. Galactic coordinates: {{coordenadas}}. Write that down, because I won't repeat it.
textos.Aperta o gatilho da primeira arma da moc: Pulls the trigger on the first weapon in your inventory that has ammo, energy or Ki to fire. Bind it to a key: each weapon has its own delay between shots.
textos.Aperta quem esta nos seus bracos (+4 de: Squeezes whoever is in your arms (+4 damage) and undoes four points of the progress they'd made struggling free. If no one is grabbed, it grabs whoever is in front of you.
textos.Apertar o Kaio-ken de novo com esta tela: Pressing Kaio-ken again with this screen open also turns it on. While it's on, the same button turns it off -- or X does. Mastery only grows while it's on: slowly up to x20, and very slowly after that (up to x50).
textos.Aponta a direção da masmorra mais próxim: Points toward the nearest dungeon -- without giving the coordinates.
That outsider has a strange ki...
Nobody gets hungry here. It's weird.
textos.Arlia, o mundo dos insetos -- pequeno, d: Arlia, the insect world -- small, harsh and forgotten.
textos.Arma de energia: o tiro vale o que a ARM: Energy weapon: each shot is worth what the GUN is worth, and it doesn't kill. The reserve can be refilled and doubled for a price.
textos.Arma de ki: o tiro vale o que a ARMA val: Ki weapon: each shot is worth what the GUN is worth and doesn't kill, and every shot costs a bit of your Ki.
textos.Arma de pólvora: o tiro vale o que a ARM: Gunpowder weapon: each shot is worth what the GUN is worth, no matter who owns it. One box of ammo refills the magazine.
textos.Arranca a alma de alguem NOCAUTEADO e vi: Rips the soul out of someone KNOCKED OUT and alive at your side: their energy becomes yours, part of their power stays with you, and they die a second later. Each soul can only be taken once, and the same body can't be absorbed again for five minutes.
textos.Arrasa tudo num raio de {0} tiles: fere,: Levels everything within {0} tiles: it wounds, tears off limbs, poisons and brings down the scenery. Arming it drops it on the ground with the countdown already running; anyone who picks it up before zero disarms it. With a code recorded, a detonator with the same code can set it off from afar.
textos.As Esferas do Dragão de {0} se apagam ju: The Dragon Balls of {0} go dark along with the world that held them. {1} will answer no one now.
textos.As Super Esferas têm o tamanho de um pla: Super Dragon Balls are the size of a planetoid: they can't be carried. Defenders don't have to beat the thief -- just knock them down or drive them away from the ball.
textos.As esferas ainda se refazem: faltam {0}: The Dragon Balls are still re-forming: {0} real hours to go. This is the list of what {1} grants.
textos.As esferas deste mundo estão INERTES: só: This world's Dragon Balls are INERT: only their creator can awaken them. This is the list of what their dragon grants.
textos.As esferas usam o SEU poder: quem criou: The Dragon Balls run on YOUR power: the set's creator can't be amplified by them -- and wishing for this would end the summoning.
textos.As inscricoes fecharam! {0} jogador(es): Registration is closed! Players: {0}, guest fighters: {1} -- all fighting for the title!
textos.As inscricoes foram ENCERRADAS pela orga: Registration has been CLOSED by the organizers!
textos.As raças de ovo têm filho sozinhas: o ov: Egg-laying races have children on their own: the egg hatches as the next character someone creates, of your race and lineage. One egg at a time, and only once you're grown.
textos.As sete Super Esferas se separam e voam: The seven Super Dragon Balls split apart and fly off to the far reaches of the galaxy.
textos.As sete Super Esferas são suas, e você f: The seven Super Dragon Balls are yours, and you speak the Language of the Gods. SUPER SHENRON grants ONE wish.
The seven Super Dragon Balls are yours, and you speak the Language of the Gods. {0}
textos.As sete esferas de um mundo nunca saem d: A world's seven Dragon Balls never leave it: drop one on another planet and it comes back on its own. After a wish, they go dark and scatter again.
textos.As sete são suas, mas só a LÍNGUA DOS DE: The seven are yours, but only the LANGUAGE OF THE GODS awakens Super Shenron: divine ranks know it, and those of Kai or Demigod blood are born with it. Lend the seven to someone who speaks it -- the wish is still yours.
textos.As sete voltam pra você na hora, e a pro: The seven come back to you at once, and the proxy ends.
textos.Assente no chão, aparafuse e dê uma freq: Set it on the ground, bolt it down and give it a frequency: anyone with a PDA, a camera computer or a communicator on that frequency will know who it sees.
This is how {0} looks when you fire it.
textos.Assume a postura de {0}. Maestria {1} de: Takes up the stance of {0}. Mastery {1} of {2}. Mastery rises by fighting and training in THIS style, and gets rusty in the ones you leave unused -- that's why choosing matters.
textos.Atrasa cada passo e cada golpe. Em troca: Slows every step and every strike. In return, training pays off much more. They start light (50 kg): you buy the maximum weight, and wear whatever percentage of it you want.
textos.Até o limite do corpo: já chegou: Up to your body's limit: already reached
textos.Até o limite do corpo: {0} → {1} kg ({2}: Up to your body's limit: {0} → {1} kg ({2})
Up to {0} pieces, each in its own color.
textos.Avanca com o Ki Shield na frente e empur: Charges forward behind your Ki Shield and shoves everyone in the way. Requires the shield to be up -- without it there's nothing to bash with. Same cooldown as Sword Strike.
textos.Avanca marcando todos no caminho; o segu: Dash forward, marking everyone in your path; press again within 5s to unleash 10 strikes split among the marked.
textos.BILLS FOI DERRUBADO NA TERRA por {{nome}: BEERUS WAS KNOCKED DOWN ON EARTH by {{nome}}! The God of Destruction has opened his own home to anyone who wants to train: {{coordenadas}} ({{mundo}}). Everyone's star chart now marks the spot.
textos.Baixar é na hora e NÃO esconde você de n: Lowering is instant and does NOT hide you from anyone -- only relaxing does. The less power in use, the faster stamina comes back. To go up: hold the Ki charge key (gradually) or get ready.
textos.Baratear custa 1 ponto; encarecer devolv: Lowering it costs 1 point; raising it gives 1 back. Steps of 40, minimum 20 — the default is already the minimum.
textos.Basta estar com você: a roupa e o respir: Just carrying them is enough: the spacesuit and the rebreather work in a vacuum, and the Nav System opens the Nav tab. The radar and the earrings are used from the inventory (I key).
textos.Bata como quem quer destruir alguma cois: Hit like you want to destroy something, not like you're apologizing.
textos.Bem acima da sua maestria ({0}x mais dre: Well above your mastery ({0}x more drain): if you're knocked out while it's active, your body tears itself apart.
textos.Bills está {{rumo}}. Dizem que ele cochi: Beerus is {{rumo}}. They say he naps, and only wakes up when someone hits him.
textos.Bills se mudou: a casa dele agora fica e: Beerus has moved: his home is now at {{coordenadas}} ({{mundo}}). Everyone's star chart now marks the new spot.
textos.Bom dia a todos. Não reparem no humor: o: Good morning, everyone. Don't mind his mood: Lord Beerus has woken up like this since the universe began.
textos.Bombeia Ki nas pernas e avanca tres tile: Pumps Ki into your legs and dashes three tiles toward your MARKED target (up to twenty tiles away). It doesn't hit: it's the step for closing the distance. The faster you are, the less it costs.
textos.Bonito golpe. Pena que eu já não estava: Lovely strike. Pity I was already gone.
textos.Bora lutar um pouco? Só até um de nós ca: Up for a little fight? Just until one of us gets tired.
textos.CAÇAR o vilão {0} (eliminá-lo enquanto o: HUNT the villain {0} (take them out while they're online)
textos.CELL ATINGIU A FORMA PERFEITA! Um poder: CELL HAS REACHED HIS PERFECT FORM! Monstrous power radiates from him!
textos.CELL FOI DESTRUIDO! A Terra esta a salvo: CELL HAS BEEN DESTROYED! Earth is safe!
textos.COMO AS RAÇAS FUNCIONAM NESTE SERVIDOR?: HOW DO RACES WORK ON THIS SERVER?
textos.Cabelo ate a cintura, sobrancelhas somem: Waist-length hair, and the eyebrows vanish. Requires SSJ2 at half mastery (50%). Brutal drain.
textos.Cabem {0} técnicas na sua cabeça. Esqueç: Your head only holds {0} techniques. Forget one to make room.
textos.Cada jogador escolhe a própria raça na c: Each player picks their own race when creating a character.
textos.Cada membro FERIDO da ate +5% de BP -- q: Each INJURED limb grants up to +5% BP -- the closer it is to breaking, the more it gives. All six at their peak at once: +20%, and you recover 25% of your Ki and stamina.
textos.Cada planeta corre o próprio dia: a hora: Every planet runs on its own day: the time and the sky here aren't Earth's.
textos.Cada pontinho e um SISTEMA. Clique pra s: Each dot is a SYSTEM. Click to select, DOUBLE-CLICK to open the system map -- the star in the center, the worlds on their orbit rings. Drag to pan, wheel to zoom.
textos.Cada ponto de fôlego a mais devolve 1 po: Each extra point of stamina cost gives back 1 creation point. Minimum 1.
textos.Cada {0} pontos de tecnologia dão mais u: Every {0} technology points give one more purchase, and at 100 there's no cap.
textos.Cai em VOCÊ (marque alguém com duplo cli: Applies to YOU (double-click someone to target another body).
textos.Cai no CORPO MARCADO (o do duplo clique): Applies to the MARKED BODY (the one you double-clicked), not to you.
textos.Cala (ou descala) o alvo marcado. Vale p: Mutes (or unmutes) the marked target. Applies to the account, not just the character.
textos.Canaliza os proprios demonios na forma M: Channels your inner demons into Majin form: part of your power becomes a flat bonus, physical offense rises 30%, Ki regenerates faster and anger builds more slowly. Press again to return to normal.
textos.Cancela o torneio em andamento: solta to: Cancels the ongoing tournament: releases everyone, removes the NPCs, nobody gets a prize.
I'm tired of walking. Let's sit down.
I'm tired. Not of you -- of standing.
textos.Capturar o nocauteado à frente: Capture the knocked-out creature in front of you
textos.Carne de caça, tirada de um bicho abatid: Game meat, taken from a slain animal. It really fills you up -- far more than fruit.
textos.Carrega antes de sair e prende você no l: Charges before firing and roots you in place while it lasts — in exchange, it presses on and grinds the target down. It's the only type with adjustable range and strength-over-distance.
Alright, show me what you've got.
textos.Chama o elemento que dorme em você e o v: Calls up the element sleeping inside you and wears it like armor. What it adds depends on WHICH element it is. Drains Ki and stamina, and drops on its own when either one runs out.
textos.Chame para o seu lado quem vai falar por: Bring whoever will speak for you to your side: this has to be done in person.
textos.Chega. Você ainda apanha feio... mas apa: Enough. You still take a beating badly... but better than when you got here.
textos.Chegue mais perto para falar com o Grand: Get closer to speak with the Grand Elder.
textos.Cinco almas condenadas fugiram da fila:: Five damned souls slipped out of line: knock out five different ones in Hell.
textos.Clique na tecla de qualquer linha e aper:
Click the key on any row and press the key you want. ESC cancels.
Bindings belong to this MACHINE: they apply to all your characters and persist after you close the game.
textos.Clique no mapa para alternar entre o mun: Click the map to switch between the whole world and the close-up view.
textos.Clique num penteado. Marque a cor pra ti: Click a hairstyle. Check the color box to dye the hair as well (a Saiyan's hair won't take dye).
textos.Clique numa peça pra fazê-la: ela vai pr: Click an item to make it: it goes into your inventory. Hover over each one to see its price.
textos.Colher DNA de um nocauteado: Collect DNA from a knocked-out target
textos.Com 3 pedidos o dragão não atende Ressus: With 3 wishes the dragon won't grant Revive EVERYONE or Kill someone (only dragons with up to 2 wishes do).
textos.Com alguem AGARRADO (se so estiver segur: With someone GRABBED (if you're only holding them, you lift them up on the spot), you charge forward knocking down whatever is in the way and slam the one you're carrying at the end -- the more walls, the harder. The ground around you cracks.
textos.Com alguem CARREGADO, voce dispara pra f: While CARRYING someone, you shoot forward, dragging their body along the ground for several tiles, and they come out of it hurt.
textos.Com ele na mochila você veleja: na marge: With it in your inventory you can sail: at the shore, facing the water, set sail -- the water no longer stops you, and you don't wear yourself out like swimming does. It docks on its own when you reach dry land.
textos.Com o poder inteiro: relaxa. O seu poder:
At full power: relax. Your power drops to the minimum, no one can sense your energy anymore (not even a scouter) and your stamina comes back as fast as it possibly can -- but you're genuinely weak, and you can't do it while enraged. While relaxed, or anywhere below 100%: get ready, and your power comes back in full instantly.

The state shows on the status panel and in the Ki tab.
textos.Com o scouter ligado, segure {0} pra fal: With the scouter on, hold {0} to talk on the radio ({1} is still your nearby voice; hold both to send on both). Anyone with a scouter on the same frequency receives it: on the same planet, or up to {2} tiles away in space. It only comes through the left ear.
textos.Comeca a cultivar uma Semente Senzu: um: Starts growing a Senzu Bean: a minute later it sprouts from the ground one step south of where you are -- just pick it up. One at a time.
textos.Comeca uma sessao de treino: marca o seu: Starts a training session: records your current power so you can measure the gain later.
The month of {0} begins. Today is {1}.
textos.Comida quente das provisoes da Sala do T: Hot food from the Time Chamber's provisions. It really fills you up -- and another serving appears in its place once this one runs out.
textos.Como quiser. Descansar também é treino -: As you wish. Resting is training too -- just ask Lord Beerus.
textos.Concentra Ki na mao e solta um RAIO cont: Gathers Ki in your hand and fires a continuous BEAM. Press once to charge, again to fire, and again to stop. While charging and firing you stay ROOTED in place -- that's the price of a beam, and that's why it's the weapon of choice once you've opened up some distance.
textos.Concentra toda a sua energia sobre o pla: Focuses all your energy on the planet you're standing on and splits it in half. Costs 1000 Ki, requires an expressed BP of 10,000 times the local gravity, and takes thirty seconds to charge -- if you're knocked out in the meantime, nothing happens. After that the planet has five minutes left, then it vanishes from the map FOREVER. Villains only.
textos.Confere as fichas das almas que chegam -: Checks the records of arriving souls -- and always has a job for anyone saving up the price of a trip back to life.
textos.Confia as sete a alguém AO SEU LADO, pra: Entrusts the seven to someone NEXT TO YOU, to speak to the dragon on your behalf. The wish is still yours -- you choose, they only speak it -- and you can take them back at any time.
textos.Congela todo mundo a vista por alguns se: Freezes everyone in sight for a few seconds (longer the higher your Ki skill, shorter the stronger the target). Requires more than a quarter of your Ki -- and HALF of what you have is spent, just once, if anyone gets frozen.
textos.Conjuradores agressivos, na linhagem do: Aggressive conjurers from King Piccolo's bloodline.
textos.Conserta o corpo de um androide de absor: Repairs the body of an absorption android, which the regenerator can't heal: stand still for ten seconds without taking hits, and every damaged part gains ten health.
textos.Consulta, de qualquer lugar, as câmeras: Views the cameras on its frequency from anywhere.
Count on me. Wherever you go, I'll follow.
textos.Conter o poder numa porcentagem e relaxa: Holding your power at a percentage and relaxing both require ki control (Basic Ki Control 5).
textos.Contra um Androide caido: absorve-o inte: Against a downed Android: absorbs them whole. Against anyone else who's down: starts DRAINING their energy, a tenth every 0.7 s, as long as they're right next to you -- and they die if their energy drops below a tenth. Press again, take a hit or go down, and the drain stops.
textos.Convida quem está na sua frente pra Danç:
Invites whoever is in front of you to do the Fusion Dance. You BOTH need to know the dance, be the same race (Half-Saiyan counts as Saiyan) and have similar apparent power -- the weaker one must express at least {0}% of the stronger one's.

If they accept, you both perform the choreography: {1} letters each. Get everything right and the fusion comes out whole. Miss a single step and it comes out too weak to even transform.

Whoever invites CONTROLS the body, and the fusion lasts {2} minutes at rest -- less the higher the transformation.
textos.Convívio · quanto vocês já conviveram: Familiarity  ·  how much time you've spent together
textos.Copia o nome e a aparencia inteira de qu: Copies the name and entire appearance of whoever you've marked (or the closest person, within five tiles) -- for everyone who looks. Press again to go back to being yourself.
textos.Corre a notícia: Bills foi derrubado na: Word is going around: Beerus was knocked down on Earth and welcomes anyone who wants to train at his home -- {{coordenadas}} ({{mundo}}), marked in purple on the star chart. They say the gravity there crushes the weak.
textos.Corre em você o sangue de uma linhagem v: The blood of a swift, technical lineage flows in you, heir to the three-eyed warriors.
textos.Cospe de volta todo mundo que está dentr: Spits everyone inside you back out, on their feet right beside you. You lose the power, the techniques and anything else you had because of them.
textos.Cospe uma bola de acido pra frente. Fere: Spits a ball of acid forward. It hurts like a strong shot and POISONS whoever it hits: for three seconds their body keeps losing a little health. Takes a tenth of your full Ki.
Spits {0} back out, on their feet beside you. You lose the power and techniques you had because of them.
textos.Crava os dentes em quem estiver colado e: Sinks your teeth into whoever is pressed up against you. It feeds you -- sating your hunger in one go -- and every so often the blood grants power that DOESN'T go away. That gain has a five-minute cooldown.
textos.Crava um ponto no tempo guardando seu co: Pins a point in time, saving your body exactly as it is now: health, energy, stamina, age, location -- even whether you were alive. Using it again sends you back to that instant and erases the point. It undoes even your own death.
textos.Cria uma copia sua com METADE do seu pod: Creates a copy of yourself with HALF your expressed power that obeys the Split Form verbs in the Other tab (follow, stop, attack target, attack nearest, dispel). Costs half your max Ki divided by your splitting skill, and every living copy lowers your own power. It vanishes on its own after 100 s, or when it goes down.
textos.Cruzado, jab e uppercut -- a combinacao: Cross, jab and uppercut -- the combination that opens strong. It doesn't advance: it's for when you're ALREADY up close and want to unload three hits without taking a step.
textos.Cuidado com a poeira, senhor Bills: poei: Mind the dust, Lord Beerus: dust ruins the seasoning of anything.
textos.Cuidado com o norte. Tem gente esquisita: Watch out up north. There are some weird folks out there.
textos.Cuidado. Tem gente aqui que destruiu pla: Careful. Some people down here have destroyed entire planets.
textos.Cura a armadura de toda construção a um: Repairs the armor of every construction within one tile of you. Whatever has already fallen won't come back.
textos.Cura o alvo marcado por completo -- memb: Fully heals the marked target -- limbs included, without reviving. With no target (or with yourself marked), opens the list of who's online.
textos.Cura o corpo inteiro de uma vez e mata a: Heals your whole body at once and sates your hunger. The body only takes one at a time. "Aid" gives the bean to someone unconscious next to you.
textos.Curandeiros e criadores, com regeneração: Healers and creators, with unmatched regeneration.
textos.Custa 90% do seu Ki maximo. A esfera se: Costs 90% of your max Ki. The sphere forms above you in 3 s and then GROWS in 1.5 s pulses; every player within reach of your Sense (except the dead in the Other World) gets the request and can donate a tenth of their own Ki to feed it -- with your Sense at universe level, the whole universe. Press again to throw it: it launches 2 s later, in the direction you're facing, and you're stuck in place until 3 s after the throw.
textos.DANCA DA FUSAO com {0}! Acerte as {1} le: FUSION DANCE with {0}! Get all {1} letters right -- if either of you slips up, the fusion comes out botched.
textos.DE ONDE VEM O SEU POVO?: WHERE DO YOUR PEOPLE COME FROM?
textos.DEMONIC SAIYAN · carregando, fique PARAD: DEMONIC SAIYAN · charging, stay STILL · {0} s
textos.DEMONIC SAIYAN · reservas em 300% a cada: DEMONIC SAIYAN · reserves at 300% every 15 s
textos.DEMONIC SAIYAN! A esfera verde se rompe: DEMONIC SAIYAN! The green sphere bursts -- and every 15 s your Ki and stamina go to 300%, until the fight is over.
textos.DEMONIC SAIYAN: uma esfera verde te envo: DEMONIC SAIYAN: a green sphere surrounds you -- stand STILL for 15 s. Moving cancels the charge.
textos.DEPOSITAR {0} zeni no cofre da Terra (ve: DEPOSIT {0} zeni in Earth's treasury (Rank Duty verb)
textos.DESABAFO · gritando, o ki explode pra to: OUTBURST · screaming, ki bursts out in every direction · {0} s
textos.DETALHES TRANCADOS · vocês ainda não c: DETAILS LOCKED  ·  you two haven't spent enough time together yet. At {0} familiarity (you have {1}) you'll see this person's age, rank and story. Just by staying nearby: {2}.
textos.DISPUTA DE KI contra {0}! Acerte as letr: KI CLASH against {0}! Hit the letters to push.
textos.DISPUTA DE KI: {0} Acerte as letras pra: KI CLASH: {0} Hit the letters to push.
textos.DNA trancado: só você vê as câmeras e lê: DNA locked: only you can view the cameras and read the log through it.
textos.DNA trancado: só você vê as câmeras por: DNA locked: only you can view the cameras through it.
textos.DOMINANDO A FERA VOCE ENTENDEU O QUE ELA: BY MASTERING THE BEAST YOU UNDERSTOOD WHAT IT IS: Super Saiyan 4 is within your reach. Rise to it whenever you like.
textos.DUELO PELO TITULO DE GOD OF DESTRUCTION:: DUEL FOR THE TITLE OF GOD OF DESTRUCTION: {0} (God) VS {1} (challenger)! No fusion; weapons and clothing only. A knockout decides it!
textos.DUELO PELO TÍTULO DE GOD OF DESTRUCTION:: DUEL FOR THE TITLE OF GOD OF DESTRUCTION: Beerus (God) VS {{nome}} (challenger)! One on one; a knockout decides it.
textos.Da macas. Dez por vez, e leva um tempo p: Grows apples. Ten at a time, and it takes a while to regrow the ones that were picked.
textos.Da um marco de habilidade a cada jogador: Gives every player on the server a skill milestone.
textos.Da um marco de habilidade ao alvo marcad: Gives the marked target a skill milestone. With no target, gives it to you.
textos.Dar à criatura ao lado: Give to the creature beside you
textos.De 1 pra cima anda de 1 em 1 até 5; de 1: Above 1 it goes in steps of 1 up to 5; below 1, in steps of 0.2 down to 0.2.
Which address each player is connected from.
Studies at the research bench. It's the only way to gain technology.
textos.Deita e dorme 5 s. Sem ser incomodado, c: You lie down and sleep for 5 s. Left undisturbed, each limb heals a good deal (60% of its health). Moving, acting or getting hit wakes you up and wastes the sleep. 1 min cooldown, whether you sleep it through or wake up early.
Leaves the surface and rises into space.
Let's save it for after lunch.
textos.Deixa {0} pra tras -- **so funciona se a: Leaves {0} behind -- **only works if someone taught it to you**. What you bought with your own milestones can't be forgotten here. No milestones come back (not even the ones the master's lesson cost).
Within your mastery: your body can take it. The Kaio-ken drains Ki, stamina and a bit of your body while it's active.
textos.Dentro do raio o corpo QUEIMA:: Inside the radius your body BURNS:
textos.Deposita e saca zeni. O que fica no banc: Deposit and withdraw zeni. Whatever you keep in the bank isn't lost when you die.
textos.Derruba o que há a um tile de você -- co: Knocks down whatever is within one tile of you -- constructions, built walls and the scenery itself -- as long as your technology can match its durability (or it's yours). Every use has a cost.
textos.Derruba todos os efeitos temporarios de: Clears every temporary effect on you.
textos.Desafia FORMALMENTE o portador do titulo: FORMALLY challenges the title holder. Requires awakened God Ki; a knockout decides it.
textos.Desconecta o alvo marcado. Ele pode volt: Disconnects the marked target. They can come back.
textos.Desejo supremo: GRAVADO nestas esferas (: Supreme wish: ENGRAVED on these Dragon Balls (The Strongest in the Universe).
textos.Desejo supremo: não gravado. Ele só se g: Supreme wish: not engraved. It can only be engraved when the statue is raised.
textos.Desfaz o vinculo com o aluno que estiver: Ends your bond with the student in front of you.
textos.Desfaz o vínculo com {0} (vale de qualqu: Ends your bond with {0} (works from anywhere, whether they're in the world or not). What you taught stays with them; this card goes away.
textos.Desiste do livro em obra. **Voce perde t: Gives up on the book in progress. **You lose everything you'd written so far** -- just like in the original.
textos.Desligado: você aperta, ele carrega, e a: Off: you press, it charges, and the charge stays in your hand until you press the technique again to release it. Pressing before the charge completes cancels it.
textos.Desperta a magia: palavra de poder e rit: Awakens magic: words of power and rituals.
textos.Desperta o ki divino do alvo marcado, ig: Awakens the marked target's God Ki, ignoring the BP requirement. With no target, yours.
textos.Destranca a Sala do Tempo pro alvo marca: Unlocks the Time Chamber for the marked target. The safety valve for when there's no Guardian.
textos.Destroyer Sphere (orbe roxo que aplica H: Destroyer Sphere (a purple orb that applies Hakai on contact)
textos.Destruction God's Fury (feixe amarelo qu: Destruction God's Fury (a yellow beam that pierces the guard, straight to the torso)
textos.Deus da Destruição: tarefa pendente -- {: God of Destruction: pending task -- {0}. Time left: {1}.
textos.Devolve OUTRA pessoa aos 25 anos -- o au: Takes SOMEONE ELSE back to age 25 -- their prime, never younger.
textos.Dez usos. Cura bem mais que uma bandagem: Ten uses. Heals much more than a bandage.
textos.Dispensar qual aprendiz? (ele perde o ki: Which apprentice will you dismiss? (they lose the kit and get their milestones back)
textos.Dizem que existe uma pizza com queijo qu: They say there's a pizza with cheese that stretches. What a fascinating concept.
textos.Dizem que o Sr. Kaioh mora no fim do Cam: They say King Kai lives at the end of Snake Way.
textos.Dizem que os grandes guerreiros mantêm o: They say great warriors get to keep their bodies after they die.
textos.Dizem que uns vilões de verdade aparecem: They say some real villains show up around here sometimes.
Word is someone saw a light in the sky yesterday.
textos.Doa um decimo do seu Ki -- e o seu poder: Gives a tenth of your Ki -- and your full power -- to the Spirit Bomb someone is forming who asked for your energy.
textos.Dois contra um é falta de educação. Suma: Two on one is bad manners. Get lost, both of you.
textos.Domina o Oozaru e volta ao seu corpo. Ex: Reins in the Oozaru and returns you to your own body. Requires control over the beast -- and a Golden Oozaru doesn't revert at will: it either tires out or becomes Super Saiyan 4.
textos.Domínio sem soberano por perto se perde:: A domain with no ruler nearby slips away: tribute dwindles, the garrison gets slack and the people end up tearing the flag down. Show your face.
textos.Dragon Radar: as Esferas do Dragão ACORD:
Dragon Radar: the AWAKE Dragon Balls on this world. You're at the center; north is up.
Click to change the range.

textos.Duas fases: primeiro você escolhe o tama: Two phases: first you choose the size of the blast and start gathering energy, rooted in place; then you press again to detonate. The longer you charge, the stronger it gets -- and past twenty-five seconds of charging you'll probably DIE with it.
textos.Duas maquinas assassinas surgiram na Ter: Two killing machines have appeared on Earth: ANDROIDS 17 and 18 are spreading destruction!

Gives a soul to someone who has none.
textos.Dá o nome quem pisou primeiro num mundo: The name is given by whoever first set foot on a generated world (once, and while it has no owner) or by whoever rules the planet.
textos.Dê à sua criatura solta ao lado: ela fic: Give it to your released creature next to you: it gets three points smarter and understands more orders.
textos.E isto... isto é o que se conhece como u: And this... this is what is known as a Super Saiyan that has ascended past a Super Saiyan.
textos.E ja que as regras acabaram... deixem-me: And since the rules are gone... allow me to introduce my children. Play with them while I finish this fight.
textos.E o seu fim!: This is the end for you!

textos.Elas continuam gravadas e nao mandam nad: They stay saved and send nothing. If you go back to the character that has these actions, the key starts working again on its own.
textos.Ele repete, sim. {{coordenadas}} -- nas: Oh, he will repeat it. {{coordenadas}} -- on your star charts, the world shows up as {{mundo}}. And bring a snack. For me, preferably.
textos.Eleito. Taxa até 30 zeni por hora, comis: Elected. Taxes up to 30 zeni per hour, commissions the police and puts bounties on people's heads.
textos.Em que pe a historia do Bills esta (dorm: Where Beerus's story stands (asleep, on his way and the day he lands, on Earth, at home), whether he and Whis exist right now, and his home's address.
textos.Em que pe esta o torneio: inscricoes, ch: Where the tournament stands: sign-ups, bracket, the current fight -- or when the next one is.
textos.Empurra Ki para dentro dos músculos e a: Forces Ki into your muscles and your physical offense skyrockets. Costs five times the normal energy drain while it's on. You can only sustain one of these at a time.
textos.Empurra UM passo: dormindo -> a caminho: Advances it ONE step: asleep -> on his way (as if Buu had fallen) -> lands on Earth (as if the month had passed) -> beaten (he says where he lives and goes home). Press again for each step.
textos.Encara a lua cheia e vira Oozaru. Sem do: Stares at the full moon and turns into an Oozaru. Without control over the beast, you can't control what it does until it tires out.
textos.Encurtar custa 1 ponto; alongar devolve: Shortening it costs 1 point; lengthening it gives 1 back. Steps of 0.4s, minimum 0.2s.
textos.Energy Nullification (apaga ataques de k: Energy Nullification (erases ki attacks weaker than you; 5 min cooldown)
textos.Enma Daioh BATE o carimbo: \"O seu coraç: King Yemma SLAMS down his stamp: "Your heart is BLACK with malice! There's only one place for the likes of you... HELL!"
textos.Enma Daioh abre o livro dos mundos: \"Po: King Yemma opens the book of worlds: "For {0} zeni, {1} days among the living -- still dead, halo and all. Choose the world: {2}."
textos.Enma Daioh carimba a sua ficha: \"De vol: King Yemma stamps your record: "Back to the land of the living!"
textos.Enma Daioh carimba a sua ficha: o campea: King Yemma stamps your file: the Other World champion returns to the land of the living!
textos.Enma Daioh carimba um passe na sua ficha: King Yemma stamps a pass on your record: "{0} days among the living -- not one more. You're still DEAD: the halo stays, and when your time is up your soul comes back here."
textos.Enma Daioh franze a testa: a sua ficha n: King Yemma frowns: your record refuses to be erased ({0})
textos.Enma Daioh lê a sua ficha: \"Uma alma eq: King Yemma reads your record: "A balanced soul. You may rest in the Other World -- or go back, for {0} zeni. You have {1}."{2}
textos.Enma Daioh troveja: \"Os vivos não têm n: King Yemma thunders: "The living have no business at my desk! Out of here until your time comes!"
King Yemma thunders: "The living have no business at my desk!"
textos.Enma Daioh: \"Duas almas num corpo só? D: King Yemma: "Two souls in one body? Undo the fusion before you ask for a new life."
textos.Enma Daioh: \"Nem todo o zeni do univers: King Yemma: "Not all the zeni in the universe can buy one more day for someone who's already lived all of theirs."
textos.Enma Daioh: \"Não conheço mundo nenhum c: King Yemma: "I know of no world called '{0}'. Choose: {1}."
textos.Enma Daioh: \"O passe custa {0} zeni. Vo: King Yemma: "The pass costs {0} zeni. You have {1}."
textos.Enma Daioh: \"Ou, por {0} zeni, {1} dias: King Yemma: "Or, for {0} zeni, {1} days among the living -- dead, halo and all, and back here at the end. And anyone tired of who they are can REINCARNATE: start over, with an echo of 10% of their power."
textos.Enma Daioh: \"Reencarnar apaga {0} PARA: King Yemma: "Reincarnating erases {0} FOREVER. You're reborn from scratch -- but with far greater potential. If that's really what you want, write the name -- "{1}" -- and I'll stamp it."
textos.Enma Daioh: \"Sua ampulheta virou pela ú: King Yemma: "Your hourglass has turned for the last time -- there's no coming back from old age. Only reincarnation remains for this soul."
textos.Enma Daioh: \"Uma alma que escolhe recom: King Yemma: "A soul that chooses to start over... so be it. Go -- be reborn. You'll be reborn with far greater potential." {0} is gone.
textos.Enma Daioh: \"Você já tem um passe carim: King Yemma: "You already have a stamped pass."
textos.Enma Daioh: \"Você não tem como pagar a: King Yemma: "You can't pay for the trip back! Come back when you have {0} zeni."{1}
textos.Enma Daioh: \"{0} não tem chão pra receb: King Yemma: "{0} has no ground to receive anyone right now."
textos.Enquanto estiver com você, a aba Nav exi: While you carry it, the Nav tab is available: the galaxy's star chart and the autopilot. Without it, the menu has nothing to show.
textos.Enquanto estiver com você, dá pra respir: While you carry it, you can breathe in a vacuum. It fits over your face, costs more, and embarrasses no one.
While you carry it, you can breathe in a vacuum. Heavy and ugly, but nobody suffocates in style.
Until someone makes up their mind, I'll take a nap. Whis, only wake me for food. Or if someone hits me.
textos.Ensina a Buster Barrage. (O comentário d: Teaches Buster Barrage. (The DM's comment promises Self-Destruct, but its code belongs to the East Kai.)
textos.Ensina a Expansão Corporal (x2 ataque fí: Teaches Body Expansion (x2 physical offense, x1.2 endurance, /1.2 speed, -2% stamina per second).
textos.Ensina a Explosão de Ki (x2 poder de ki,: Teaches Ki Explosion (x2 ki power, -2% stamina per second) and Self-Destruct.
textos.Ensina a {0} a técnica que você inventou: Teaches {0} the technique you created. They must already have unlocked that type of technique and have a free slot among their {1}. It costs no milestones, and they can't pass it on.
textos.Ensina o Kaio-ken e a Genkidama (a mesma: Teaches the Kaio-ken and the Spirit Bomb (the same as King Kai's).
textos.Ensina o {0} a quem estiver na sua frent: Teaches {0} to whoever is in front of you. The student needs {1}% divine mastery and can't have taken up the other discipline -- the two are mutually exclusive, and there's no going back.
textos.Entra no corpo do jogador nocauteado mai: Enters the body of the nearest knocked-out player and drives it with their power -- the world sees the body's owner, with ashen white hair, and they can only watch. When the body goes down, you're thrown out and return to your own.
textos.Entrega o volante do corpo fundido ao se:
Hands the wheel of the fused body to your other half. The fusion's power doesn't change -- only who's driving does. Only whoever is in control can use it.

(It doesn't exist in Namekian fusion: there's no one left there to take the wheel.)
textos.Então foi neste planetinha que derrubara: So this is the little planet where they beat that pink bubblegum. Hmph. They woke me from a decades-long nap for this.
textos.Então nada de lasca desta vez. Tudo. E c: Then no sliver this time. All of it. And with rage.
So, no one else... KA... ME... HA... ME...
That's all? I'm not even fully awake.
textos.Ergue {0} da sua memória, dentro da sua:
Conjures {0} from your memory, inside your mind, with their full stats -- their transformations, their stages and their power as of today. It's training: they can't sever limbs or kill, nothing that happens comes back with you, and there's no Zenkai.

Only works in YOUR mind, and only if you're alone in it.
textos.Escolha UMA vez, pra sempre, onde mora o: Choose ONCE, forever, where your core lives. As long as that limb is intact (neither broken nor severed), the core brings you back from death with 5% of everything -- twice; the second time, it detonates and destroys the limb.
textos.Escolha como a armadura vai ser. Depois: Choose what the armor will look like. Once it's shaped, it goes into your inventory, ready to wear.
textos.Escolha como os pesos aparecem no corpo: Choose how the weights look on your body when you wear them.
textos.Escolha o corpo de cada degrau. Trocar o: Choose the body for each stage. Changing bodies puts you back in your starting form.
textos.Escolha o planeta: você aparece lá na ho: Pick the planet: you appear there instantly, along with anyone right next to you. It takes all your Ki.
textos.Escolha uma linhagem. A escolha é defini: Choose a lineage. The choice is permanent, and until you choose, this skill does nothing.
textos.Escolhe em qual habilidade da Mente o se: Chooses which Mind skill your studying will concentrate on. Focus_Skill with no name lists yours and says which one is chosen; Focus_Skill:none drops the focus and goes back to learning a little of everything.
textos.Escolhe uma skill ou uma técnica de ki s: Pick one of your skills or ki techniques to teach {0}: stand RIGHT NEXT to them. They accept or decline through the prompt that shows up on their screen.
textos.Escolhe {0} como o foco do seu ESTUDO. S: Picks {0} as the focus of your STUDY. On its own this changes nothing: the focus only counts while you STUDY someone further along in it than you (mark the person and use Study) -- then only that one advances, and it advances TEN TIMES faster than unfocused study.
textos.Escolher depois (Esc) -- a armadura fica: Choose later (Esc) -- the armor stays in your inventory
textos.Escreve um livro sobre uma habilidade da: Writes a book about a Mind skill you've already leveled. You can only write while MEDITATING, and it takes one minute per level you have in it. The book goes into your inventory and teaches anyone who already knows that skill and is still at HALF your level or below -- it vanishes once read. Write_Teachings:stop gives up and loses what was written.
textos.Escreve um livro sobre {0}. So se escrev: Writes a book about {0}. You can only write while MEDITATING, and it takes one minute per level you have in it. The book goes into your inventory and teaches anyone who already knows the skill and is at HALF your level or below.
textos.Esferas de Estrela Negra (um set global,: Black Star Dragon Balls (one global set, scattered across planets)
textos.Esquecer — tem certeza? O que depende de: Forget — are you sure? Everything that depends on it goes too.
This person hasn't written a story.
textos.Esse teto sobe com a tecnologia, até o m: This cap goes up with technology, up to the game's maximum at 100.
textos.Esta habilidade ainda não existe neste j: This skill doesn't exist in this game yet: {0} is still missing. That's why it isn't sold -- and anyone who had bought it got their milestones back.
textos.Esta porta vai ter senha?: Should this door have a password?
textos.Este lugar não tem clima próprio (o `Has: This place has no weather of its own (the DM's `HasWeather=0`) -- but forcing works.
textos.Este mundo dá a volta: quem sai por uma: This world wraps around: leave by one edge and you come back in from the opposite one.
textos.Este mundo guarda uma Sala do Tempo. A p: This world holds a Time Chamber. The door is in a mountain wall near the landing spot; get close to it and press E -- the door's rules tell you how much time stretches inside.
textos.Este mundo não tem Estátua do Dragão --: This world has no Dragon Statue -- and without a statue there are no Dragon Balls here. Only a Namekian of the Dragon Clan can raise one, on a world they rule (or on Earth, as the Guardian).
textos.Este servidor e o seu jogo estão na mesm: This server and your game are on the same version ({0}), but they're different builds (the protocol changed): the server's is {1} and your game's is {2} — update both to the same build.
textos.Este servidor está na versão {0} e o seu: This server is on version {0} and your game is on {1}: your game is AHEAD — the server hasn't been updated yet.
This server is on version {0} and your game is on {1}: your game is OUT OF DATE — update the game.
textos.Este servidor não informou a versão dele: This server didn't report its version: it's an old server, from before the version check. Your game is on {0} — the server needs to be updated.
textos.Este é o dia e o céu da Terra. Cada outr: This is Earth's day and sky. Every other planet runs on its own day and its own sky.
This is my body. ALL of it.
textos.Estou ocupado. Entre na fila -- ou vá in: I'm busy. Get in line -- or go bother Whis.
I'm out of breath. Some other day.
textos.Estoura a própria velocidade muito além: Pushes your speed far beyond its normal limit. Your body pays the price: energy drains five times faster while it lasts. You can only sustain one of these at a time.
It's way too hot to train.
I'd end up hurting you. Better not.
I warned you I wake up grumpy.
textos.Eu estava sonhando com um banquete. Você: I was dreaming about a feast. You're going to pay for every dish.
I was about to ask the same thing.
I died in such a stupid way...
I didn't do anything wrong... well, almost nothing.
textos.Eu sou perfeito. Esmagar vocês assim ser: I am perfect. Crushing you like this would be such a waste... My tournament begins in {0} day(s). Come at me one at a time.
textos.Extrai e guarda amostras de DNA de quem: Extracts and stores DNA samples from someone who's knocked out. Take them to a Bio-Android Lab: "Collect DNA" at the lab empties the container's samples into the tank.
textos.Extrair DNA de quem está caído: Extract DNA from someone who's down

textos.FREEZA FOI DERROTADO EM NAMEK! As Esfera: FRIEZA HAS BEEN DEFEATED ON NAMEK! The Dragon Balls are safe!
textos.FREEZA FOI DERROTADO! O Planeta Vegeta e: FRIEZA HAS BEEN DEFEATED! Planet Vegeta is safe!
textos.FREEZA ergue um dedo ao céu -- e uma SUP: FRIEZA raises a finger to the sky -- and a SUPERNOVA begins to form above {0}! Nothing can touch him while it grows...
textos.FREEZA vai destruir {0}: uma DEATH BALL: FRIEZA is going to destroy {0}: a DEATH BALL is growing above him, and nothing can touch him while it grows!
textos.Vai ficar voando a luta toda? Covarde!: Gonna fly around the whole fight? Coward!
textos.Fugindo pro ceu? Que covardia!: Running off to the sky? How cowardly!
textos.Isso e um torneio, nao um show aereo! De: This is a tournament, not an air show! Get down, coward!
textos.Luta aqui embaixo, covarde, se tiver cor: Fight me down here, coward, if you've got the guts!
textos.Fala direto na mente de qualquer pessoa: Speaks straight into the mind of anyone in the world, with no distance limit. It can't reach anyone hidden, Androids, or anyone whose energy is too weak to be found. Send it without a target to see who you can reach.
textos.Falem baixo: o senhor Bills dorme leve q: Keep your voices down: Lord Beerus is a light sleeper when it comes to noise, and a heavy one when it comes to work.
textos.Falta poder de BASE pra o ki divino desp: You lack the BASE power for God Ki to awaken in you -- forms, anger and Kaio-ken don't count. Until then, time spent here fills nothing.
textos.Falta zeni pra gravar o supremo: ele cus: Not enough zeni to engrave the supreme wish: it costs {0}.
textos.Faltam recursos pra gravar o supremo: el: Not enough resources to engrave the supreme wish: it costs {0}.
textos.Faltam {0} dia(s) para o TORNEIO DO {1}: {0} day(s) left until the {1} GAMES in Earth's arena.
textos.Faltam {0} marco{1}: custa {2} e você te: Not enough milestones: {0} more needed (it costs {2} and you have {3}).
textos.Faz quanto tempo que você morreu?: How long ago did you die?
textos.Faz um membro decepado voltar a crescer,: Makes a severed limb grow back, or fully heals the most injured one.

Regrows a severed limb, or fully heals your most injured one. Costs 70% of your MAX Ki and has a 10s cooldown -- it's the only healing you have in the middle of a fight: your body doesn't mend on its own while the fight is still on.
textos.Faz um vilão de saga já derrotado escapa: Makes an already-defeated saga villain break out in Hell right now (if none has been defeated yet, one is pulled from the saga chain, for testing). Whoever defeats them earns zeni and karma. One at a time.
textos.Fecha o que está aberto. Devagar, e só f: Closes open wounds. Slowly, and only outside combat.
Stay away from the pools of blood.
textos.Fica observando alguem a ate dez tiles e: Watches someone within ten tiles and learns from what you see: every second, each Mind skill that person has at a HIGHER level than yours advances your progress in it. Study_Other:<name> starts it; pressing again stops it. Losing sight of the target also stops it. With a skill in FOCUS the gain is ten times bigger -- but only for that skill.
textos.Fio Psiquico LIGADO: o duplo clique no c: Psycho Thread ON: double-clicking the ground now sets a thread beneath you.
textos.Fio Psiquico desligado: o duplo clique v: Psycho Thread off: double-clicking goes back to Zanzoken.
textos.Fique colado nele: a oferta aparece na t: Stay right next to them: the offer shows up on their screen with Accept and Decline ({0} s). The number is how many milestones the lesson requires. ★ = master's lesson (something you wouldn't teach a stranger): that one SPENDS their milestones; the others only require them to have them.
textos.Fique pro chá: medite 3 minutos dentro d: Stay for tea: meditate for 3 minutes inside Princess Snake's palace.
textos.Fora da arena? Essa regra é inútil. A pa: Ring-outs? That rule is pointless. From now on it no longer applies -- the fight goes on!
The legend's divine form: a flat 60x.
textos.Forma divina: 56x fixo. Rompe o teto do: Divine form: a flat 56x. Breaks through the Saiyan body's ceiling.
textos.Força: até o teto da sua tecnologia: Power: up to your tech cap
textos.Força: com o scouter ligado a leitura de: Power: with the scouter on, the power reading is the one in the Scan tab — this screen doesn't show power numbers.
textos.Força: você ainda não sabe sentir Ki (a: Power: you can't sense Ki yet (the Sense skill). With it, the card of anyone within range shows their power next to yours, as a percentage — the same reading as the Sense tab.
textos.Freeza TRANSFORMOU-SE! Sua nova forma pu: Frieza has TRANSFORMED! His new form pulses with even greater power! (Form 2)
Frieza has TRANSFORMED! His new form pulses with even greater power! (Form 3)
Frieza has TRANSFORMED! His new form pulses with even greater power! (Form 4)
Frieza falls to his knees on Planet Vegeta.
textos.Freeza chegou a Namek atras das Esferas: Frieza has reached Namek in search of the Dragon Balls! The Namekians are in danger!
textos.Freeza estala o pescoco. -- Voces me obr: Frieza cracks his neck. -- You've forced me to transform.
textos.Freeza partiu em direcao a Namek atras d: Frieza has set out for Namek after the Dragon Balls! He will arrive in {0} days.
textos.Freeza se aproxima de Namek... chegada e: Frieza draws closer to Namek... Days until arrival: {0}.
textos.Frost Demon (ativa): um kiai joga quem e: Frost Demon (active): a kiai blows away anyone nearby, and wrath takes over -- BP +20%, max Ki -20%. Recharge: 3 min.
textos.Frost Demon mutante, com o golpe letal l: Mutant Frost Demon, with lethal blows on: executes whoever is down in front of you (3 s standing still). Anyone within 50 tiles who isn't your friend gets -10% to all stats for 2 min. Recharge: 5 min.
textos.Frost Demon mutante: por 1 min, cada gol: Mutant Frost Demon: for 1 min, each unguarded hit that lands adds +5% damage, up to +100%. Recharge: 5 min.
textos.Frost Demon: a carga das técnicas de ki: Frost Demon: ki techniques charge 2x faster, and ki damage goes up 15%.
textos.Frost Demon: o nocaute na metade do temp: Frost Demon: knockouts last half as long, and each badly hurt limb takes less damage (up to -25% below 10%).
textos.Frost Demon: transformar com o tronco fe: Frost Demon: transforming with an injured torso heals your limbs (+20%), restores severed ones (at 10%) and speeds up Ki charging for 1 min -- for Bio-Androids, upon entering Super Perfect. Recharge: 3 min.
textos.Frost Demon: um kiai joga quem está pert: Frost Demon: a kiai blows away anyone nearby, and wrath takes over -- BP +20%, max Ki -20%, with no time limit. You can swallow it back down after 30 s (that's when the 3 min recharge starts).
textos.Fugir também é uma técnica. Não das melh: Running away is a technique too. Not one of the better ones.
textos.Gah... voce e mais forte do que eu pensa: Gah... you're stronger than I thought!
textos.Gasta 1 dos {0} pedidos que restam nesta: Uses 1 of the {0} wishes left in this summoning.
textos.Gasta fôlego além da energia (devolve {0: Costs stamina on top of energy (gives back {0} points — requires {1} spent)
textos.Gastar uma melhoria (1 físicos, 2 Ki, 3: Spend an upgrade (1 physical, 2 Ki, 3 misc, 4 power)
textos.GoD: NOVA TAREFA -- DESTRUIR o mundo {0}: GoD: NEW TASK -- DESTROY the world {0}. Deadline: {1}. Failing weakens your hold on the seat.
textos.GoD: NOVA TAREFA -- ELIMINAR a ameaca {0: GoD: NEW TASK -- ELIMINATE the threat {0}. Deadline: {1}. Failing weakens your hold on the seat.
textos.GoD: TAREFA CUMPRIDA ({0}). O equilibrio: GoD: TASK COMPLETE ({0}). The balance thanks you.
textos.GoD: a ameaca fugiu do plano fisico. Nov: GoD: the threat fled the physical plane. A new task is coming soon.
textos.God's Temper (10 danos seguidos sem bloq: God's Temper (10 hits taken in a row without blocking = +10% physical offense/defense for 10s)
textos.Grava a planta dos SEUS blocos erguidos: Records the blueprint of YOUR built blocks in a 30 by 30 square around you, and later rebuilds whatever falls -- block for block, far cheaper than building.
textos.Grava agora todos os personagens, o mund: Saves all characters, the world and the ranks right now.
textos.Grava ate dez frases que viram atalhos d: Saves up to ten phrases as speech shortcuts. Send it with no argument to see yours, or with a number and text to save one. Once saved, the phrase comes out with a single command.
textos.Gravar O MAIS FORTE DO UNIVERSO nestas e: Engrave THE STRONGEST IN THE UNIVERSE on these Dragon Balls
textos.Grave nela a senha de uma porta: quem CA: Record a door's password on it: whoever CARRIES the key walks through the door without typing anything. It also locks your own door with the recorded password.{0}
textos.Grave um código e dispare: no fim da con: Record a code and trigger it: when the countdown ends, every bomb with the same code goes off wherever it is.
textos.Gravidade, pesos e a Sala do Tempo multi: Gravity, weights and the Time Chamber multiply what each training tick yields. Beyond what your body can take, the ground crushes you: you lose health and speed, and at 4x you're pinned.
textos.Guarda o rosto de quem voce marcou. Ele: Remembers the face of whoever you've marked. They'll show up in the People tab.
textos.Guarda ou solta a tecnica da Miragem. De: Switches the Afterimage technique off or on. While it's off, you don't blink (double-clicking the ground won't take you there), you leave no afterimage when dashing or dodging, and you stay out of Zanzoken clashes. Press again to turn it back on.
textos.Guarda sangue por tempo indeterminado. D: Stores blood indefinitely. Donating costs you a bit of your health; only a vampire gets anything out of drinking it.
textos.Guarda todo o zeni do bolso. O que esta: Deposits all the zeni you're carrying. What's in the bank isn't lost when you die.
textos.Guarda uma criatura que luta por você: s: Holds a creature that fights for you: release it, and it follows and obeys. It levels up by fighting, and each level grants an upgrade. The smarter it is, the more orders it understands.

Toggles swimming. Only works with water in front of you (or beneath you): you can't cross water on foot -- only by swimming or flying.

While swimming you take the flying pose WITHOUT leaving the ground, move more slowly and drain Ki little by little; the more you swim, the cheaper it gets. Reaching dry land turns it off automatically, and so does running out of Ki (then you're carried to the shore).
textos.Liga e desliga os fios dos Herans. Com e: Turns the Heran threads on and off. textos.Liga e voce passa a cuspir duas esferas: Turn it on and you start spitting out two spheres per cycle in RANDOM directions, until you turn it off, go down or run out of energy. Each cycle costs one base drain. It doesn't root you in place.
