textos.Mergulhe na própria mente pra lutar cont:
Dive into your own mind to fight an exact copy of yourself -- same power, same speed: the fight measures your skill, not your BP.

Nothing in there is real: injuries do NOT come back with you, there's no Zenkai, and training yields only a quarter of the usual. Your body stays meditating where it was -- anyone who hits it wakes you up instantly.

To wake up on your own: press the meditate key again, or the button at the top of the screen.

If you meditate RIGHT NEXT TO someone who's already in a trance, you enter THEIR mind (and their reflection fades away: only the two of you remain in there).

textos.Na aba Sense, o botão Teletransportar le: In the Sense tab, the Teleport button takes you to that person. Anyone meditating within 1 tile comes along if you're meditating too; anyone you're holding or carrying comes along. Costs energy and gets easier the more distance you travel. Mastery (+2% per completed trip; Yardrat +3%) lowers the Ki down to a quarter and the concentration down to a fifth -- and on anyone within sight it drops to 0.2 s, fast enough to use mid-fight.

textos.Nenhuma regra deste port a acende. No jo: No rule in this port unlocks it. In the old game it opened through a path that hasn't been brought over yet.
textos.Nenhuma árvore ainda. Elas vêm da raça,: No trees yet. They come from your race, your class and what you train.
textos.Nenhuma, ainda. Nada garante que exista: None yet. Nothing guarantees there are any -- and if there are, they don't come on a training schedule: they come when they come.
textos.Neste servidor a raça é sorteada: você n: On this server your race is rolled at random: you were born {0}{1}.
textos.Ninguém ao alcance do dragão: quem o des: No one within the dragon's reach: whoever the wish is for needs to be next to you.
textos.Ninguém chamado \"{0}\" no alcance do se: No one named "{0}" within range of your {1}.
textos.Ninguém lê o próprio poder de luta sem u: No one can read their own Battle Power without a device to measure it, or without Sense at system level. Turn on a scouter in the Equip tab.
textos.Ninguém mais desafiou {0}. Ele junta as: No one else challenged {0}. He brings his hands together... a KAMEHAMEHA is about to fall on Earth, and nothing can touch him while he charges! Only a ki beam of equal power can stop it.
textos.Ninguém mais? Mais um minuto... e a Terr: No one else? One more minute... and Earth is finished.
No one in your field of view.
textos.Nivel tecnologico, construcoes e android: Tech level, constructions and androids. Comes with the technology system.
textos.No chão você não sai do lugar: só voando: You can't move on the ground, only by flying (both legs lost).
textos.Nome, idade e a história que te trouxe a: Name, age and the story that brought you here.
textos.NÃO fala a Língua dos Deuses: não conseg: does NOT speak the Language of the Gods: won't be able to summon
textos.Não conte a ninguém, mas eu quase caí no: Don't tell anyone, but I almost fell in the river.
textos.Não fere ninguém: enche o lugar de fumaç: Doesn't hurt anyone: fills the area with smoke for {0} seconds.
textos.Não há Estátua do Dragão neste mundo --: There's no Dragon Statue on this world -- and without a statue there are no Dragon Balls. Only a Namekian of the Dragon Clan can raise one, and only on a world they rule (or on Earth, if they're the Guardian).
textos.Não há Guardião da Terra no momento: só: There's no Earth Guardian at the moment: only an administrator can let you out.
textos.Não há ninguém para trazer de volta (que: There's no one to bring back (those who died of OLD AGE can't come back through any wish).
There's no one to bring back.
textos.Não há para onde ser mandado: {0} não é: There's nowhere to send you: {0} isn't a place on the map of the universe, it's a plane of existence. No one takes off from here -- here, you are reborn.
It doesn't belong to any of your trees.
textos.Não pendem de nenhuma árvore que este pa: These don't belong to any tree this panel lists: they came from a master, or from a path that only opens up through play.
I don't want to hurt you.
textos.Não se animem. Isso foi uma lasca do meu: Don't get excited. That was a sliver of my power, and I was still sleepy.
textos.Não se apresse por minha causa. Estou só: Don't rush on my account. I'm just counting how many plates of curry fit in one afternoon.
textos.Não se preocupem: ele só derruba. Destru: Don't worry: he only knocks you down. Destroying you would take effort, and effort is the one thing he avoids more than salad.
textos.Não sobrou nada vivo perto de onde era c: Nothing is left alive near what used to be home.
textos.Não sobrou quase ninguém em {0}. O plane: Almost no one is left on {0}. The planet is dying.
textos.Nível máximo: não há mais o que melhorar: Max level: nothing left to upgrade.
textos.Nível {0} ({1}/s, estoque de {2}): {3} z: Level {0} ({1}/s, {2} max stock): {3} zeni or {4} resources
textos.O Anjo. Carrega o Ultra Instinto por def: The Angel. Carries Ultra Instinct by definition -- and it's from the Angel that the teaching chain flows down.
textos.O DOBRO do maior poder do jogo -- e UM A: DOUBLE the highest power in the game -- and ONE YEAR to live. There's no coming back from that death.
textos.O DOBRO do maior poder do jogo, e UM ANO: DOUBLE the highest power in the game, and ONE YEAR to live. Whoever PAYS has to accept in person.
textos.O DRAGÃO DAS SUPER ESFERAS: THE DRAGON OF THE SUPER DRAGON BALLS
textos.O Deus da Destruição. Não envelhece, res: The God of Destruction. Doesn't age, breathes in a vacuum, and wields Hakai. Losing the title takes EVERYTHING away on the spot.
textos.O Enma me olhou feio, mas me deixou fica: King Yemma gave me a dirty look, but he let me stay.
King Yemma showed me no mercy.
textos.O GOD OF DESTRUCTION adiou o desafio de: The GOD OF DESTRUCTION postponed {0}'s challenge. ({1}/{2} postponements this week)
textos.O GOD OF DESTRUCTION defendeu seu titulo: The GOD OF DESTRUCTION defended the title against {0}.{1}
textos.O GOD OF DESTRUCTION defendeu seu título: The GOD OF DESTRUCTION defended his title against {{nome}}.
textos.O God of Destruction FALHOU em manter o: The God of Destruction FAILED to keep the balance... ({0}/{1})
textos.O God of Destruction manteve o equilibri: The God of Destruction kept the universe in balance. {0}
The Namekian Grand Elder appoints {0} as {1}.
Hell. You can't get here by ship.
textos.O KI DIVINO DESPERTOU EM VOCÊ. O seu cor: GOD KI HAS AWAKENED IN YOU. Your body now holds an energy that can't be sensed from outside -- calm, immense, and yours.
textos.O Kaioh do Norte. Ensina a quem tem cora: The North Kai. He teaches those with a pure heart -- and laughs at his own jokes.
textos.O Mais Forte do Universo (a VIDA por pod: The Strongest in the Universe (your LIFE for power)
textos.O PESO ESTÁ ESMAGANDO SEU CORPO! Você ma: THE WEIGHT IS CRUSHING YOUR BODY! You can barely crawl. Take off the weights NOW (P menu, Tech tab) or it won't hold out.
Heaven. You can't get here by ship.
textos.O SSJ4 levado ao limite. Exige o SSJ4 do: SSJ4 pushed to the limit. Requires a mastered SSJ4. 32x, up to 50x.
textos.O Super Shenlong só é chamado AO LADO de: Super Shenron can only be summoned NEXT TO a Super Dragon Ball: go to one of them, out in space.
textos.O TORNEIO DE ARTES MARCIAIS vai comecar!: The WORLD MARTIAL ARTS TOURNAMENT is about to begin!
The WORLD MARTIAL ARTS TOURNAMENT is about to begin! 1v1 fights all the way to the final.
textos.O TORNEIO DO OUTRO MUNDO vai comecar!: The OTHER WORLD TOURNAMENT is about to begin!
textos.O TORNEIO DO OUTRO MUNDO vai comecar! So: The OTHER WORLD TOURNAMENT is about to begin! Only the dead may fight.
textos.O TORNEIO DO {0} COMEÇOU! Ele espera na: THE {0} GAMES HAVE BEGUN! He's waiting in Earth's arena: step into it to challenge him, one at a time. Leave the arena and you lose, get knocked out and you lose -- and everyone gets just one chance.
textos.O Torneio de Artes Marciais DO OUTRO MUN: The OTHER WORLD Martial Arts Tournament is open for registration! Souls of the Other World: answer the invitation. (closes in {0} min)
textos.O Torneio de Artes Marciais comecou as i: The World Martial Arts Tournament is open for registration! Players on Earth: answer the invitation. (closes in {0} min)
textos.O alvo está marcado: os verbs com \"Targ: Target marked: the verbs with "Target" and the buttons below act on them. Type the skill name, the rank key, or the message.
textos.O anel DOURADO em volta de um mundo gera: A GOLDEN ring around a generated world marks a DIVINE ATMOSPHERE: they're rare, and anyone with enough base power awakens God Ki by staying on one.
textos.O anel ROXO marca o mundo onde o Bills m: The PURPLE ring marks the world where Beerus lives: its gravity crushes anyone who lands unprepared. The "Beerus's home" button on the bar takes the chart there.
textos.O assistente do Guardião: cultiva sement: The Guardian's assistant: grows Senzu Beans and opens the gate to the Sacred Water.
textos.O atalho secreto entre o Reino Divino e: The secret shortcut between the God Realm and Arconia. Costs HALF your energy and takes along anyone right next to you. Only works when you're standing still and in one piece.
textos.O ataque de {0} ENGOLIU o Kamehameha de: {0}'s attack SWALLOWED {1}'s Kamehameha! {2} was DISINTEGRATED -- Earth is saved!
textos.O ataque de {0} foi INTERROMPIDO! Ele fo: {0}'s attack was INTERRUPTED! He was knocked out before he could release the energy!
textos.O avesso do Masenko: um raio fino que GA: The opposite of Masenko: a thin beam that GAINS power with every tile and reaches twice as far. In exchange it takes six times longer to charge -- and that wait, right in the enemy's face, is its price.
textos.O basico do boxe: um jab pra medir e um: Boxing basics: a jab to measure the distance and a stronger cross over the top. You take a step forward before the first one, so it catches anyone two tiles away.
textos.O botão do meio e os laterais do mouse (: The middle and side mouse buttons (Mouse 3, 4 and 5) also work as keys.
textos.O cabelo se ergue e doura. 2x ate domina: Hair stands on end and turns gold. 2x until mastered; 6x at 100% mastery.
textos.O caminho do Oozaru -- e o único que che: The path of the Oozaru -- and the only one that reaches Super Saiyan 4.
textos.O caminho do juiz do Outro Mundo: leva V: The Other World judge's own path: it takes YOU to Heaven or Hell, instantly. Send it without a destination to see both.
The judge's path between the two worlds. In the world of the living it takes you to the Other World, to King Yemma's desk, where souls arrive -- and there, Revive brings back whoever deserves it (the soul wakes up at home). In the Other World, the same button returns you to the EXACT spot you left from.

Costs no energy. Can't cross while down, held or in a trance; anyone piloting disembarks first.
textos.O catalogo de construcoes, com o custo e: The construction catalog, with each one's cost and, for the ones you can't build, the reason why.
textos.O cerco que FECHA: as bolas nascem em vo: The ring that CLOSES IN: the balls form around the target, hang still for ONE SECOND and then all converge on it at once. Twice the damage of Ki Minefield at more than three times the price.
textos.O ceu desta zona agora: o que esta caind: This zone's sky right now: what's falling, how hard, and what can fall here.
textos.O chefe dos quatro. Não se reivindica de: The head of the four. It can't be claimed from outside: you rise to it.
The ground on {0} starts splitting open on its own.
The Capital Ship's main computer. From here you pilot the ship, launch it, and see where it is in the galaxy. It can't be built: it comes with the ship.
textos.O contrario do Foco: voce racionaliza o: The opposite of Focus: you ration your spending and your energy lasts MUCH longer, at the cost of part of your Ki offense. Press again to turn it off.
Body data hasn't arrived from the server yet.
textos.O corpo de Freeza se desfaz sobre a terr: Frieza's body crumbles away on the green soil of Namek.
textos.O corpo desvia sozinho, sem a mente mand: The body dodges on its own, without the mind giving the order. Dodge chance scales with your CURRENT accuracy.
textos.O corpo incha até mais de quatro vezes o: Your body swells to over four times its normal size: much more strength and physical defense, but less speed. Consumes stamina while it lasts. Press again to turn it off.
textos.O corpo incha e o verde toma a aura. 12x: The body swells and green takes over the aura. 12x to 20x.
textos.O corpo vira algo parecido com aço e a d: Your body turns into something close to steel and your physical defense rises sharply. Energy drain is five times higher for as long as you hold that density. One of these at a time.
textos.O corpo volta aos 25 anos, o auge -- o s: The body goes back to age 25, its prime -- yours, or someone else's within the dragon's reach.
textos.O corpo volta aos 25 anos, o auge. Só pr: Your body goes back to age 25, its prime. Only for yourself can you pick age 10 -- and 10 costs 9% of your power.
textos.O céu de TODA a galáxia escurece... {0}: The sky across the ENTIRE galaxy goes dark... {0} has summoned SUPER SHENRON in the Language of the Gods!
textos.O céu de {0} se abre. O planeta vai vive: The sky over {0} clears. The planet will live.
textos.O céu range... {0} vestiu a carne de um: The heavens groan... {0} has donned mortal flesh: {1}'s body is now THEIRS. ({2})
textos.O desejo do Zamasu. PRIVILÉGIO PRÓPRIO:: Zamasu's wish. SELF ONLY: it disappears from the menu while you're wishing on someone else's behalf.
textos.O desejo do Zamasu: você veste o corpo d: Zamasu's wish: you take over the body of a living Saiyan, and God Ki tints your forms ROSE.
textos.O desejo foi realizado... e as Super Esf: The wish has been granted... and the Super Dragon Balls, drained, have scattered across the galaxy once more.
textos.O desejo mais antigo do jogo. Cria a cal: The oldest wish in the game. Conjures up someone's panties -- for wearing on your head.
textos.O diário deste vínculo começa agora: o q: This bond's log starts now: whatever they taught you before this wasn't recorded.
This bond's log starts now: whatever you taught {0} before this wasn't recorded.
textos.O dragão cansa de esperar pelo próximo p: The dragon grows tired of waiting for the next wish and vanishes into the clouds.
textos.O dragão desaparece nas nuvens sem que n: The dragon vanishes into the clouds without anyone making a wish.
textos.O dragão solta o potencial que você guar: The dragon releases the potential you stored by training and fighting: 1.5x what is stored. A Namekian with God Ki also gains Potential Unleashed and Orange.
textos.O dragão já liberou tudo o que dormia em: The dragon has already unlocked everything that slept within you.
textos.O dragão sente o que dorme num Namekusei: The dragon senses what sleeps within a Namekian -- but your power doesn't reach God Ki yet. Come back stronger.
textos.O dragão te ensina a Dança da Fusão. Pra: The dragon teaches you the Fusion Dance. To fuse, both of you need to know it, be the same race and have similar power.
textos.O duelo de {{nome}} contra Bills foi ANU: {{nome}}'s duel against Beerus was VOIDED: someone butted in.
textos.O efeito mecânico desta habilidade ainda: This skill's mechanical effect hasn't been ported yet.
textos.O ego que se alimenta da dor: 66x. Entra: The ego that feeds on pain: 66x. Entering it restores your energy to 100%.
textos.O feitio de cada arte do original + a co: Each look keeps the original game's shape + YOUR ki color on top. Beam: Beams and Techniques; ball: Blasts; homing: Techniques.
textos.O guardiao ruge -- e o cabelo dele levan: The guardian roars -- and his hair stands up, blazing gold.
textos.O guardião da Torre. Cultiva as sementes: The guardian of the Tower. He grows the Senzu Beans.
The guardian bound to the Master Emerald.
textos.O instinto completo: 66x, cabelo pratead: Instinct perfected: 66x, silver hair. Entering it restores your accuracy to 100%.
textos.O jarro do Mirante. Solta o potencial qu: The jar from the Lookout. It releases the potential you stored by training and fighting, and leaves a bit more of it -- and kills anyone whose body can't take it. Once per hour.
textos.O juiz do Outro Mundo: julga as almas e: The judge of the Other World: judges souls and decides who goes back.
textos.O juiz dos mortos. Lê a sua ficha e cobr: The judge of the dead. He reads your record and charges for your return.
The leader of the rogue Saibamen.
textos.O mais forte da estirpe. Cobra tributo d: The strongest of the bloodline. Collects a tribute of fear by destroying worlds.
textos.O multiplicador é o que o seu BP base vi: The multiplier is what your base BP has turned into right now; effective power is how much of it your body can actually put out.
textos.O mundo do seu povo, com o chão que algu: Your people's own world, with land someone drew by hand.
textos.O mundo em que você está, com o norte em: The world you're in, with north at the top. The marker is you. Click to switch between the whole world and a close-up view.
textos.O mundo gelado da estirpe que cobrou tri: The frozen world of the clan that made the entire universe pay tribute.
textos.O mundo que você escolhe aqui decide qua: The world you pick here decides which peoples you can be born into -- where you'll actually wake up is up to your people, later on.
textos.O mundo vermelho dos guerreiros, e o chã: The red world of warriors, and the heaviest ground anyone chooses to live on.
textos.O nome, os pedidos por invocação e os de: His name, the wishes per summoning and which wishes he grants, in the statue menu. Remaking scatters the seven again.
textos.O norte é em cima. X cresce para o leste: North is up. X grows to the east and Y to the south, in tiles from the top-left corner.
textos.O orçamento é {0}, e ele é um TETO. Reba: The budget is {0}, and it's a CAP. Lowering power, raising the energy cost, lengthening the charge or slowing the shot GIVES BACK points — but only what you've already spent: you can never hold more than {1}.
The egg of someone from an egg-laying race. It hatches when someone creates a new character and chooses to be born from it -- the child comes out right next to it. A single punch breaks it, and the child is lost.
textos.O par de brincos dos Kaioshin. Mire algu: The Kaioshin's pair of earrings. Target someone and throw one of them: if they accept, you fuse on the spot -- any race, no dance, for a full half hour. The pair can also be given away: mark the person and use "Give to marked target". In the hands of someone who isn't a Kaioshin, it's used up in the fusion.
textos.O pedido de {0} falha: quem criou as esf: {0}'s wish fails: whoever created the Dragon Balls can't be amplified by them.
textos.O pedido registrado não é dos que o Supe: The wish on record isn't one Super Shenron grants right now: {0} needs to pick another.
textos.O peteleco: solta quem você está AGARRAN: The flick: releases whoever you're GRABBING with the damage of {0} uncharged heavy hits to the torso, and sends them flying wherever you're facing.
textos.O planeta onde o seu povo nasce foi dest: The planet where your people are born has been destroyed. Choose where your body returns the next time you die.
The green planet of the Namekians.
textos.O planeta verde, de três sóis e nenhuma: The green planet of three suns and no night.
The TRUE power -- red sparks. Class base (Omega 2x, Epsilon 3x, Low-Class 4x), and mastery raises it to 2.016x its own value.
textos.O poder crescente dos Saiyajins chamou u: The Saiyans' growing power has drawn some terrible attention... Frieza is approaching Planet Vegeta! He will arrive in {0} days.
textos.O poder efetivo cai com Ki baixo, ferime: Effective power drops with low Ki, wounds, hunger, weights, gravity and age. Transforming doesn't affect it.
textos.O poder maximo do corpo de Hera. O multi: The Heran body's maximum power. The multiplier comes from the CLASS (Omega 1.30x, Epsilon 2.4x, Low-Class 3x), and mastery raises it to 2.016x its own value.
textos.O poder que o mundo lê (expresso) e o qu: The power the world reads (expressed) and the power training raises (base). It only exists as a number with the scouter on.
textos.O povo de {0} aclama {1} como protetor e: The people of {0} hail {1} as the planet's protector and ruler!
The people of {0} are HUNTING you now.
The people of {0} are talking about your absence.
textos.O povo de {0} te considera um HERÓI!: The people of {0} see you as a HERO!
textos.O prazo cobrou {0}. O ser mais forte do: Time has claimed {0}. The strongest being in the universe is no more.
textos.O que esta vestido e equipado. Vem com o: What you're wearing and have equipped. Comes with the item system.
textos.O que vem depois -- se vier -- você desc: What comes next -- if anything does -- you'll find out by trying.
textos.O que você escolher toma forma no chão,: Whatever you choose takes shape on the ground at your feet. It costs a good chunk of your Ki -- less the higher your esoteric skill.
textos.O que você fabrica vai pra mochila (tecl: What you craft goes to your inventory (I key); you place it on the ground from there. Everything can be paid in zeni or in resources (double) -- resources are mined from planets with the Mine verb. The ones you can build come first.
textos.O que você já absorveu não se perde. O m: What you've already absorbed isn't lost. The meter only moves on a world with a divine atmosphere, or by trading real blows with someone who has God Ki.
textos.O que você é importa mais que tudo o que: What you are matters more than anything that comes after.
textos.O que {0} escolheu. Dito, as sete se esp: What {0} chose. Once spoken, the seven scatter across the galaxy again.
textos.O raio da Escola do Grou: quatro vezes a: The Crane School's beam: four times the potency of an ordinary beam, long range and the fastest flight in the family. In return, it's the most expensive to sustain after the Death Beam.
The king of the space pirates.
textos.O ritual do Anciao: oferece a quem esta: The Elder's ritual: offers the marked person beside you (or yourself) the awakening of their dormant potential -- ONCE in a lifetime. Base power rises by a fraction for each point of the race's Potential, and the potential built up through age and training turns into power on the spot. The recipient has to accept in the Other tab.
textos.O ritual do Velho Kaiohshin: com alguém: The Elder Kai's ritual: with someone in front of you (mark them and get right next to them), you offer the ritual -- and if they accept on the card, you both stand still for {0} minutes, face to face. At the end their hidden potential awakens and they gain the Potential Unleashed form.

The Elder Kai's ritual: with someone in front of you (mark them and get right next to them), you offer the ritual -- and if they accept on the card, you both stand still for {0} minutes, face to face. At the end the potential they stored is released twice over and they gain the Potential Unleashed form -- once per character.

One ritual per day (real time); if it's interrupted before the end, the day isn't spent. During the ritual this button interrupts it -- and whoever receives the ritual sees it too.
textos.O sangue Majin te dá o selo do Majin: pu:
Your Majin blood gives you the Majin's seal: pulls someone next to you who is KNOCKED OUT and still alive into your body, instead of drinking them.

A PLAYER doesn't die: they go ALIVE into the depths of your body and face an IMAGE of you with half your power. While they're in there you use 10% of their power and their techniques, and you wear their clothes. An NPC is absorbed whole.

Sealing does NOT make you evolve: your form's milestones only advance through Absorb.
textos.O sangue de onde você vem, dentro do seu: The bloodline you come from, within your own people.
textos.O sangue escuro do clã demoníaco corre e: The dark blood of the demon clan flows in you, an aggressive caster of the old king's line.
textos.O scouter não lê poder acima de 100 milh: The scouter can't read power above 100 million, or God Ki: whatever it can't reach shows up as ???.
textos.O segredo mais profundo do Cla do Dragao: The Dragon Clan's deepest secret: shaping a Dragon Statue and bringing a set of Dragon Balls to life. The statue can only be raised on Earth (as the Earth Guardian) or on a planet you rule.
textos.O selo foi quebrado... MAJIN BOO despert: The seal has been broken... MAJIN BUU has awakened on Earth! Run!
textos.O senhor Bills não carrega mais o título: Lord Beerus no longer holds the title, so the visit ends here. I'll still welcome anyone who wants to train: {{coordenadas}}.
The lord of demons. Can Majinize.
textos.O seu Sense, no nível do sistema ou acim: Your Sense, at system level or above, feels your own power: expressed and base. Other people's power, only a scouter reads.
textos.O seu corpo absorve o ar deste mundo: fi: Your body is soaking up this world's air: stay here and God Ki will awaken. Trading blows with someone who already has it also fills the meter.
textos.O seu corpo já aprendeu a se mexer sozin: Your body has already learned to move on its own. Today's lesson is teaching your head not to get in the way -- fight with your instinct switched on and it grows faster here.
textos.O seu mestre {0} quer te ensinar {1}: cu: Your master {0} wants to teach you {1}: it costs {2} milestone(s) (you have {3}).
textos.O seu potencial já foi despertado -- o d: Your potential has already been awakened -- the dragon has nothing left to unlock in you.
textos.O seu povo não tem lar: os mundos que el: Your people have no home: every world they know is just a stopover. You start at the busiest port there is.
textos.O sistema de navegação está desligado: v: The navigation system is offline: you don't have a Nav System in your inventory. It's crafted at the research bench (Tech tab).
The sovereign of the Big Geti Star.
textos.O sol de {0} não nasce mais. O céu ficou: The sun no longer rises over {0}. The sky has turned the color of rust.
textos.O sopro em VOLTA de voce: joga longe tod: The gust goes all AROUND you: it blasts away everyone up close and SNUFFS OUT incoming energy shots, as long as you have the power for it. It's the answer when you're surrounded.
textos.O suplex: dano somado em quem esta agarr: The suplex: bonus damage on whoever you're grabbing, and they can't react for two seconds afterward.
textos.O tanque do Bio-Android Lab de {0} se ro: The tank in {0}'s Bio-Android Lab bursts open. THE CREATURE HAS AWAKENED -- and the first thing it did was kill its own creator.
textos.O teleporte dos Kaioshin: abre a tela co: The Kaioshin's teleport: opens a screen with the known planets -- the usual twelve and the generated worlds some player has already set foot on, under their given names. Pick one and you shout 'Kai Kai!' and appear there instantly, in a flash, taking along anyone right next to you. Requires FULL Ki and takes ALL of it. Reaches even Heaven.
textos.O tempo acabou e eu continuo de pé. O tí: Time's up and I'm still standing. The title stays where it is.
textos.O titulo de God of Destruction: quem car: The God of Destruction title: who holds it, the open task, failures and deadlines.
textos.O topo da escada divina. Faz o Ritual Mí: The top of the divine ladder. Performs the Elder Kai's Unlock Ability (Potential Unleashed, once a day) and takes apprentices.
textos.O torneio foi CANCELADO pela organizacao: The tournament has been CANCELED by the organizers!
textos.O torneio foi CANCELADO pelo proprio Enm: The tournament has been CANCELED by King Yemma himself!
textos.O trono saiyajin. Taxa até 100 zeni por: The Saiyan throne. Taxes up to 100 zeni per hour, puts out bounties, watches through the Crystal Ball and commands the Royal Army. Saiyans only.
textos.O título lhe EMPRESTA a Aura of Destruct:
The title LENDS you the Aura of Destruction, at {0} efficiency: whoever hits you gets hurt, incoming ki loses strength, you take less damage, and a killing blow is denied once per fight.

It runs on the PRECISION of your Ultra Instinct -- and burns through it while active. Press again to power down.
textos.O título lhe EMPRESTA a Hakai Infusion,: The title LENDS you Hakai Infusion, at {0} efficiency: for one minute your ki attacks penetrate more and are harder to deflect. Requires the 80% tier -- measured by your Ultra Instinct mastery.
textos.O título é seu. As obrigações também --: The title is yours. So are the duties -- there are lots of them, and they're all boring.
textos.OVERFLOWING KI: o seu Ki começa a transb: OVERFLOWING KI: your Ki starts to overflow -- your Ki pool grows every 10 s, and your body pays for it. Press again to let it all out (after 60 s).
textos.OVERFLOWING POWER: o poder começa a tran: OVERFLOWING POWER: your power starts to overflow -- it rises every 10 s, and your body pays for it. Press again to let it all out (after 30 s).
Pant... pant... I need to catch my breath...
textos.Oferece a quem esta na sua frente um lug: Offers whoever is in front of you a place as your student. You must be at least {0}x stronger than them (real BP, not the apparent one), and you can guide at most {1} people.
textos.Oferece a quem voce marcou a idade que v: Offers whoever you've marked the age of your choice, from 0 to 25. It's an OFFER: it only works if they accept. Use Restore_Youth:<age>.
textos.Oh. Fazia eras que ninguém me tirava do: Oh. It's been ages since anyone moved me from my spot. Congratulations -- truly.
textos.Ohoho... não demore, senhor Bills: o lám: Ohoho... don't take too long, Lord Beerus: the ramen is getting cold, and cold noodles are an unforgivable sin.
Well, look at that... thank you.
textos.Onde o seu povo te põe no mundo -- e se: Where your people bring you into the world -- and whether you'd rather wake up far away from them.
Yesterday I trained until I passed out.
textos.Os cargos do mundo: quem ocupa cada um e: The world's ranks: who holds each one and what you still need.
textos.Os defensores caídos são arrastados para: The fallen defenders are dragged away... the next wave approaches!
textos.Os deveres do seu cargo: a tarefa em abe: Your rank's duties: the open task, the deadline in in-game days, failures and renown.
textos.Os dois ataques explodem no ar! {0} junt: The two attacks explode in midair! {0} brings his hands together again...
textos.Os soldados do Freeza se espalham por Na: Frieza's soldiers are spreading across Namek -- hunting down the Namekians and the Dragon Balls!
textos.Ou você pode simplesmente chamar de Supe: Or you can just call this a Super Saiyan 2.
textos.Ouvi dizer que no Inferno tem uns monstr: I heard there are some terrible monsters down in Hell.
textos.Ouviu aquele grito? Aquele lagarto de ra: Hear that scream? It's that lizard with the tail again.
textos.Ouviu falar do torneio?: Did you hear about the tournament?

Your ACCOUNT stays yours, and you'll be able to create another character in their place. If this is really what you want, confirm AGAIN in {5} seconds.
textos.PAREDES -- barram o corpo, a vista e que: WALLS -- block bodies, sight and anyone flying
textos.PERFEICAO. O seu corpo vale {0}x o imper: PERFECTION. Your body is worth {0}x the imperfect form, and this form is yours forever.
textos.PISOS -- cobrem: debaixo deles não chove: FLOORS -- they cover: no rain falls under them, and no one sees in from outside
textos.PLANETA ESGOTADO: ela só extrai o que a: PLANET DEPLETED: it only extracts what the reserve regenerates.

textos.PRESO -- só o Guardião da Terra (ou um a: TRAPPED -- only the Earth Guardian (or an admin) can let you out

textos.PRIMAL BLOODLUST: {0} golpes sem recuo -: PRIMAL BLOODLUST: {0} hits without knockback -- and every one you take turns into +2% damage for you (for 2 min).
textos.PROGRESSO DAS SKILLS ({0}). Meditar faz: SKILL PROGRESS ({0}). Meditating makes the Ki ones rise faster:

Stops mining. Walking stops it too.
textos.Pede ao servidor a lista de quem voce co: Asks the server for the list of people you know.
textos.Pede pra quem está na sua frente terem u: Asks whoever is in front of you to have a child with you. You both need to have declared LOVE for each other (People tab) and be of opposite sexes. Same race makes the same race; Human, Saiyan and Half-Saiyan mix into a Half-Saiyan (an infinite-energy Android counts as Human). The baby is born as the next character someone creates.
textos.Pede {0} de convívio (vocês têm {1}). Só: Needs {0} familiarity (you have {1}). Just by staying nearby: {2}.
textos.Pelagem vermelha. So sai do Oozaru Doura: Red fur. Only reachable from Golden Oozaru. 20x, up to 40x once mastered.
At least you can train in peace here.
textos.Personagem de bancada, criado por linha: Test-bench character, created from the command line for testing.
textos.Perto de casa só sobrou mundo pesado. Um: Only heavy worlds are left near home. A heavy world still beats nowhere at all -- and bodies adapt to the gravity they're born in.
textos.Perto de um habitante, a tecla E abre o: Near an inhabitant, the E key opens their menu: "Give a gift" and "Train" bring you closer -- doing it again on the same day yields less and less. At 100, "Recruit" shows up. Actually hitting them resets the friendship; and if they die, it's lost.
textos.Pesca comida perto da água. Lance a linh: Catches food near water. Cast the line and stand still; when a fish bites, reel it in (use the rod again) before it gets away.
textos.Plante onde quiser: nasce uma macieira,: Plant it anywhere: an apple tree grows, bearing ten apples at a time and regrowing whatever is picked. You can also eat it -- with salt it would be delicious; without, it's just weird.
textos.Plateia demais. Aula é de um aluno só --: Too many spectators. Lessons are one student at a time -- sort out your turns among yourselves.
You can count on me, friend.
textos.Poder bruto no limite do corpo: soco mui: Raw power at the body's limit: much heavier punches, but slow, clumsy and easy to hit. Unlocks at 70% SSJ1 mastery. Time in it trains SSJ1, and its own mastery only lowers the Ki it costs.
textos.Poe a mao em quem esta do seu lado e fec: Lays your hand on whoever is beside you and closes their wounds with your Ki, continuously. The higher your Ki skill, the more it heals. If the target moves away, the healing stops on its own. Pressing again also stops it.
textos.Poe em 100% a maestria da forma em que o: Sets the mastery of the form the target is in RIGHT NOW to 100%.
textos.Poe no chao todo mundo da SUA zona. Voce: Knocks down everyone in YOUR zone. You stay standing.
textos.Poe o alvo marcado de pe, mesmo morto. S: Puts the marked target back on their feet, even if dead. With no target (or with yourself marked), opens the list of who's online.
textos.Por cinco segundos voce se move rapido d: For five seconds you move too fast for the eye to follow: you leave an afterimage every half second and other people's attacks have a much lower chance of hitting you. Needs a free hand and a bit of stamina.
For now you're their only student. Once there are others, their progress in the same teachings will show up here, next to yours.
textos.Por hoje chega. Você durou mais que a so: That's enough for today. You lasted longer than yesterday's dessert -- and that's a compliment.
textos.Power Flick (peteleco: 2x um golpe pesad: Power Flick (a flick: 2x a heavy attack, no charge-up)
textos.Pra trocar de multiplicador, apague prim: To change the multiplier, turn it off first (as in the original).
I need to get something to eat.
textos.Preciso de um parceiro de treino. Topa?: I need a training partner. You in?
textos.Preciso recuperar minhas energias!: I need to recover my energy!
textos.Prende as pernas de quem voce marcou com: Binds the legs of whoever you've marked with an aura of interference: their speed drops for a few seconds (the better your debuff skill, the less it drops, but the longer it lasts). Shares its cooldown with Paralysis and Solar Flare.
textos.Primal: por 1 min nada te segura -- sem: Primal: for 1 min nothing holds you back -- no negative effects, full power and no form drain (+30/60/90 s in SSJ4, Full Power and Limit Breaker). Recharge: 6 min.
textos.Programar pra mim, com a senha: Program it for me, with the password
textos.Projeta a mente ate alguem e sente onde: Projects your mind to someone and senses where they are and what surrounds them: the world, the time, their condition and who's nearby. It can't reach anyone hiding their power, Androids, or energy that's too weak. Observe:<name>; Observe with no name lets go.
textos.Provoca (ou guia) o aluno na sua frente: Provokes (or guides) the student in front of you into a transformation. With a master at their side, the minimum power that form requires OF THEM is cut in half -- and the cut is permanent. The student must have already seen the form, or you must have it yourself. Has a {0} min recharge.
textos.Provoca (ou guia) {0} até uma transforma: Provoke (or guide) {0} into a transformation: stand FACING them. The minimum power the form demands of them is cut in half, and it takes {1} min to recharge before you can try again.
textos.Publicar um livro na biblioteca (nº do l: Publish a book to the library (book #)
textos.Pudim. É nisso que eu estou pensando ago: Pudding. That's what I'm thinking about right now. Pudding with plenty of caramel sauce.
textos.Pula a espera da fase de agora: fecha as: Skips the current phase's wait: closes sign-ups now, zeroes the countdown, cuts the break short. During a fight, ends it on points (whoever has more health wins). Press again for each phase.
textos.Pula direto pra qualquer forma que você: Jumps straight to any form you've ALREADY awakened, without climbing the ladder step by step. It doesn't loosen any requirement: the form still demands the usual power and mastery. Send it without a number to see what's open.
textos.Pula o pavio: cinco minutos de tremor e: Skips the fuse: five minutes of quaking and the planet is gone. Anyone here with expressed BP below yours takes 99 to every limb; anyone knocked out dies; everyone else is flung into space.
textos.Puxa pra dentro de você alguém NOCAUTEAD:
Pulls someone next to you who is KNOCKED OUT and still alive into your body.

A PLAYER doesn't die: they go ALIVE into the depths of your body, wake up whole and face an IMAGE of you with half your power. While they're in there you use 10% of their power and their techniques, and you wear their clothes.

They ESCAPE if they beat the image, if they die in there, if you get knocked out or if you expel them -- and you instantly lose whatever you had because of them.

An NPC is devoured whole: it dies, and gives you the same 10% until you go down.
textos.Quando e o proximo da Terra e o do Outro: When the next Earth and Other World tournaments are, and what phase the current one is in.
When this is over, I want a parfait. One of the tall ones, with fruit right up to the brim.
textos.Quanto de poder voce ganhou desde que a: How much power you've gained since the session started.
textos.Quanto do seu poder usar. Arraste e aper: How much of your power to use. Drag it, then press the button next to it.
textos.Quanto maior o seu poder, mais: The greater your power, the longer
textos.Quanto voce tem no bolso e quanto tem gu: How much you have on hand and how much is stored. You must be at a bank.
textos.Quantos de cada raca estao jogando agora: How many of each race are playing right now.
textos.Quatro esferas soltas de uma vez, abrind: Four spheres fired at once, fanning out. None of them hurts much on its own; together they cover the whole front, and it's hard to dodge them all.
What I'd give for a blue sky...
How about trading a few blows? Nobody gets hurt.
Who's in the world right now, and where.
Who inherits Vegeta's throne, in order.
textos.Quem quiser medir forças comigo, a fila: Anyone who wants to test their strength against me, the line starts here. I'll only use a sliver of my power -- I don't want to crack the planet before I've tasted the food.
textos.Quem te acerta se machuca; ataques de ki: Anyone who hits you gets hurt; ki attacks lose strength; you take less damage; and a FATAL blow is negated once per fight, with the aura bursting out around you.
Want to train with me? Just a spar.
Wanna train with me? Just a spar.
textos.Quis o meu título e apostou a própria ex: Wanted my title and bet their own existence on it. Lost both.
textos.REVITALIZING METAMORPHOSIS: a casca nova: REVITALIZING METAMORPHOSIS: the new shell seals your wounds -- and your Ki charges faster for a minute.
textos.REVOLTA em {0}! Se você não aparecer, pe: REVOLT on {0}! If you don't show up, you'll lose your domain.
textos.ROARING EVOLUTION · {0} skill(s) perdend: ROARING EVOLUTION · skills weakening against you: {0}
textos.RUTHLESS MIND: {0} morre devagar -- e to: RUTHLESS MIND: {0} dies slowly -- and everyone around feels it.
textos.Rasga a realidade cinco tiles ao norte e: Tears a hole in reality five tiles to the north and opens the Dead Zone for ten seconds. It pulls in anyone nearby and seals whoever falls inside -- no jar, nothing to break: the only way out is to become 25% stronger than you were at that moment. Costs almost all your energy.
textos.Rasga a realidade e atravessa ate outro: Tears through reality and crosses over to another world. Requires FULL Ki and takes ALL of it: you arrive on the other side with no energy at all. Send it without a destination to see where the rift can reach.
textos.Rasga um buraco na realidade e some -- l: Tears a hole in reality and vanishes -- taking along anyone right next to you. Requires FULL Ki and takes ALL of it. A demonic power: it reaches Hell, but never Heaven. Send it without a destination to see where it can go.
textos.Rastro perdido: {0} -- fora do alcance d: Trail lost: {0} -- out of your Sense range
textos.Rastro: {0} · longe demais pra dizer ond: Tracking: {0} · too far away to tell where
textos.Re-escolhe o corpo de cada forma do Fros: Lets you pick the body of each Frost Demon form again (the Mutant's suppressions, the base and the two evolutions). Changing the bodies sends you back to your starting form.
textos.Recipiente criogenico para amostras de D: Cryogenic container for DNA samples. Use it on KNOCKED-OUT players to extract and store their DNA; take the samples to the Bio-Android Lab.
textos.Recusa a oferta de despertar o seu poten: Declines the offer to awaken your potential.
Declines the offer to be made young again.
textos.Recusa o convite de fusão pendente. (Ign: Declines the pending fusion invitation. (Ignoring it works too: every invitation expires in {0} seconds.)
textos.Recusa o convite do torneio, ou desiste: Declines the tournament invitation, or withdraws your entry while sign-ups are open.
textos.Recusa o convite ou o ensinamento penden: Declines the pending invitation or teaching.
textos.Refaz as paredes e o chao que os golpes: Rebuilds the walls and ground that attacks have knocked down in this zone.
textos.Refaz um membro perdido de um androide d: Rebuilds a lost limb on an absorption android -- your own, or that of someone downed in front of you: ten seconds standing still without taking hits.
textos.Refazer espalha as sete esferas de novo,: Redoing scatters the seven Dragon Balls again, and they sleep until they wake. The set's strength becomes your current BP.
textos.Relaxado você não está usando poder nenh: While relaxed you aren't using any power at all: get ready first.
textos.Resetar recomeça a saga do marco: os che: Reset restarts the saga from its milestone: its bosses leave the world and the day count goes back to the start -- they arrive again in form 1. Arrive now skips the warning days: bosses on their way arrive right away (a saga that hasn't started fires from its milestone and arrives on the spot). Skip closes the saga as WON, with its bosses dead (no one becomes a hero, and players hear no announcement). The other sagas stay as they are. Reset and Skip take two clicks: the first asks for confirmation, the second does it.
textos.Resistência e força enormes. Em troca, m: Huge endurance and strength. In exchange, you're slower, recover slowly and are easier to hit.
textos.Restaura todo mundo do servidor: vida, m: Restores everyone on the server: health, limbs and Ki.
textos.SADISTIC NATURE: por 1 min, cada golpe q: SADISTIC NATURE: for 1 min, every hit that lands unguarded makes the next one stronger.
textos.SECOND WIND: o fôlego volta -- Ki e vigo: SECOND WIND: you catch your breath -- Ki and stamina recover for 20 s.
textos.SEGURANDO ALGUÉM · ande pra arremessar ·: HOLDING SOMEONE · move to throw · punch to choke
textos.SEM COMIDA · o vigor não volta · coma al: NO FOOD · stamina won't come back · eat something
