textos.SHEER WILLPOWER · nada derruba você · {0: SHEER WILLPOWER · nothing can knock you down · {0}
textos.SHEER WILLPOWER: o golpe era fatal -- e: SHEER WILLPOWER: that blow was fatal -- and you simply DON'T FALL.
textos.SHEER WILLPOWER: por 15 s nada te derrub: SHEER WILLPOWER: for 15 s nothing can bring you down -- not even a fatal blow.
textos.SPIRIT DISRUPTION: o ki de {0} se desreg: SPIRIT DISRUPTION: {0}'s ki is thrown off (-{1}%).
textos.SPIRIT DISRUPTION: uma aura envolve os s: SPIRIT DISRUPTION: an aura wraps your fists and legs -- every clean hit throws off the ki of whoever takes it.
textos.SUPER SHENLONG concedeu riqueza colossal: SUPER SHENRON has granted {0} colossal wealth!
textos.SUPER SHENLONG trouxe {0} de volta à vid: SUPER SHENRON has brought {0} back to life!
textos.SUPLEX em {0}: dois segundos sem reagir: SUPLEX on {0}: two seconds unable to react (-{1} energy).
textos.SYCOPHANTIC RAGE: o ataque sai com o DOB: SYCOPHANTIC RAGE: the attack fires with DOUBLE power (sanity -{0}).
textos.SYCOPHANTIC RAGE: o ataque sai com o TRI: SYCOPHANTIC RAGE: the attack fires with TRIPLE power and costs a quarter less Ki.
textos.Sai na hora e faz curva atrás do alvo ma: Fires instantly and curves after the marked target — gently, and only up to {0}° from the heading it left on. Anyone who moves far off its path escapes.
textos.Sai na hora, não prende você, e morre em: Fires instantly, doesn't root you, and bursts on whoever it hits. Your everyday shot.
Leave without wishing. Does NOT use up the wish.
textos.Sai sozinho quando termina de carregar (: Fires on its own once fully charged ({0} points)
textos.Saiyajin: com Ki, fôlego ou vida abaixo: Saiyan: with Ki, stamina or health below half, your mortal form (base included) ADDS to the multiplier -- +0.5x, or +1x, +2x, +4x for your highest mastered form -- and every drain is cut in half.
textos.Saiyajin: com o tronco ou a cabeça abaix: Saiyan: with your torso or head below 50%, physical attack +20% and physical defense +30%.
textos.Saiyajin: do 2º golpe seguido do MESMO t: Saiyan: from the 2nd hit in a row of the SAME type onward (punch, blade or ki), each one hurts 2% less, down to -20%, for 10 s.
textos.Saiyajin: em combate, cada forma de maes: Saiyan: in combat, each mastered form you hold (10 s for the first, 20 s for the second, 30 s for the third...) is worth +10% BP, up to +60%. Dropping to a weaker form resets the count.
textos.Saiyajin: em combate, com o poder abaixo: Saiyan: in combat, with your power below 75%, 50% or 25% of the bar, Ki and stamina regen and physical attack and defense go up -- and Ki Skill goes down.
textos.Sala do Tempo: resta{0} ~{1} minuto{2} d: Time Chamber: ~{1} min of training left.
textos.Salta pra orbita de um mundo de atmosfer: Jumps into orbit around a world with a divine atmosphere (the nearest one your body can handle). Space only; touch it to land.
textos.Salta pra orbita do mundo onde o Bills m: Jumps into orbit around the world where Beerus lives. Space only; touch it to land. The gravity there is extremely high -- use "Beerus: Withstand His Gravity" first.
textos.Salta pro centro da estrela mais proxima: Jumps to the center of the nearest star. Space only -- and it BURNS.
textos.Sangue de elite corre nas suas veias. Vo: Elite blood runs in your veins. You were born far above the common warriors of your people.
textos.Sangue divino corre em você: equilibrado: Divine blood runs in you: balanced, and yet with one of the highest power potentials there is.
Mixed blood has no world of its own. Born from a pregnancy, you'd inherit your parent's planet; created here, you start on Earth.
textos.Se alimenta da alma de alguém NOCAUTEADO: Feeds on the soul of someone KNOCKED OUT and alive at your side. The victim's max energy becomes yours on the spot, and a slice of their power becomes yours as well. It doesn't kill -- but your body needs five minutes before it can do it again.
textos.Se eu cair, a Terra cai comigo! KA... ME: If I go down, Earth goes down with me! KA... ME... HA... ME...
textos.Se eu tivesse outra chance, seria difere: If I had another chance, things would be different.
textos.Se terminar logo, ainda pegamos o sushi: If you finish soon, we can still get the sushi fresh. Fish waits for no one.
If you came to train, it's either with me or with him. With me it hurts less. A little.
textos.Se você ver o Mestre, avise que eu passe: If you see the Master, say I stopped by.
textos.Segue o proprio caminho. O ganho extra d: Leaves your master to go your own way. The extra gains from training against them end too.
textos.Segue o próprio caminho. O ganho extra d: Go your own way. The extra gain from training against them ends along with the bond; what they taught you stays.
textos.Segura o seu poder nessa porcentagem, na: Holds your power at that percentage, instantly.
textos.Segura o seu próprio poder numa porcenta: Holds your own power at a percentage, from 1 to 100 -- the control is in the Ki tab of the menu, and this button takes you there. It only LOWERS your power, and does so instantly: to bring it back up, charge (hold the C key) or get ready. Holding back your power doesn't hide you from scouters or Sense -- to vanish, use Relax, in the same panel.
textos.Segure C pra reunir energia. Acima de 10: Hold C to gather energy. Above 100%, Ki adds to your power linearly (118% = 1.18x BP) up to the charge cap.
textos.Sem mapa aqui: este lugar não tem fim, n: No map here: this place has no end, and nothing that would fit on a map.
textos.Sem mapa aqui: não deu pra desenhar o ch: No map here: couldn't draw the ground of this place.
textos.Sem mapa aqui: o chão deste lugar não te: No map here: the ground of this place has no drawing to show.
textos.Sem mapa aqui: o espaço não cabe num. Qu: No map here: space doesn't fit on one. The star chart shows the worlds around you (Nav tab, with the Nav System).
textos.Sem o Freeza, os soldados dele fogem de: With Frieza gone, his soldiers flee Namek.
textos.Sem pesos. Eles se fabricam na aba Tech: No weights. They're crafted in the Tech tab and adjusted in the inventory (I key).
textos.Sem senha, ela abre pra qualquer um que:
Without a password, it opens for anyone who bumps into it.
With a password, it's a wall: only you and whoever types the password into it can get through.
textos.Semeia bolas PARADAS em volta do alvo ma: Sows STATIONARY balls around your marked target and leaves them there for four seconds. They don't chase anyone -- whoever tries to break out of the ring is the one who gets hurt. Needs a target within twenty tiles.
textos.Senta e recupera o fôlego onde você está: Sit down and catch your breath right where you are. Your body stays here, awake -- any movement key brings you out of meditation.
textos.Sente as Esferas do Dragão ACORDADAS do: Senses the AWAKE Dragon Balls on the world you're on -- and only that world. A Dragon Ball that's still re-forming won't show up.
textos.Será que alguém vai juntar as esferas pr: Think someone will gather the Dragon Balls to revive me?
textos.Seu aprendizado com o Kaioshin chegou ao: Your apprenticeship with the Kaioshin has come to an end: {0}.{1}
textos.Seu corpo é frágil, mas a sua mente e o: Your body is frail, but your mind and your mastery over ki are those of a true ancient sage.
textos.Seu domínio {0} está sendo INVADIDO por: Your domain {0} is being INVADED by {1}! Tear down their flag or pray for the garrison.
textos.Seu domínio {0} foi DESTRUÍDO. O territó: Your domain on {0} was DESTROYED. The territory is lost.
textos.Seu intelecto alimenta o seu poder. Quan: Your intellect feeds your power. The wiser you grow, the stronger you become.
textos.Seu ki, na arte padrão de raio (a do Ki: Your ki, in the default beam look (the Ki Wave's).
Your master hasn't taught you anything yet.
textos.Seu passo está {0} mais lento (corpo fer: You move {0} slower (injured body: health at {1}%).
textos.Seu poder rende {0} a menos enquanto o c: Your power is {0} lower while your body is injured.
textos.Seu progresso no que ele ensinou: Your progress in what they taught
textos.Seu projeto biológico prefere regeneraçã: Your biological design favors regeneration and brute force over endless evolution.
textos.Seu vigor nunca acaba: gastar fôlego não: Your stamina never runs out: spending it would cost you nothing, so it earns no points.
textos.Seus golpes têm {0} menos chance de acer: Your attacks are {0} less likely to hit ({1}).
textos.Sincroniza o Ki com o corpo e MULTIPLICA: Syncs your Ki with your body and truly MULTIPLIES your power -- at the cost of constantly burning energy, stamina and your body itself. Pressing it opens the multiplier choice (x2 to x100); while it's active, pressing again -- or X -- turns it off. Above your mastery everything drains faster, and a multiplier over double your mastery with your Ki running out will tear your body apart.
textos.So com alguem AGARRADO. O primeiro apert: Only with someone GRABBED. The first press starts gathering energy (you're stuck in place and the power grows every two and a half seconds); the second detonates: whoever is in your arms takes the full explosion, anyone within three tiles takes part of it -- and you take the same explosion. Charge past twenty and there's a 75% chance you DIE with them.
textos.So o Grande Anciao de Namek: oferece a q: Namekian Grand Elder only: offers whoever is marked a seat as a Cardinal Elder.
textos.So o Guardiao da Terra. Destranca, do Te: Earth Guardian only. Unlocks, from the Lookout, the door for whoever got trapped inside -- and, with no one marked, your own: trapped inside, you free yourself from within.
textos.So o Kaioshin no trono: toma como Aprend: Seated Kaioshin only: takes whoever is marked (up to 4 tiles away) as a Kaioshin Apprentice -- with no one marked, shows who nearby is eligible.
textos.So o Kaioshin: mostra os seus aprendizes: Kaioshin only: lists your apprentices so you can dismiss one -- they lose the kit and get their milestones back.
textos.So o Presidente da Terra, e so com a tar: President of Earth only, and only while the funding task is open: deposits the funds into Earth's treasury.
textos.So o Rei de Vegeta: poe quem esta marcad: King of Vegeta only: puts whoever is marked in the line of succession to the throne.
textos.So quem sabe fazer a chave (o Guardiao d: Only those who know how to make the key (the Earth Guardian and Master Korin). Gives the marked target ONE entry into the Time Chamber -- and, with no one marked, the key is yours.
textos.Sobe a SUA maestria de gravidade ate a d: Raises YOUR gravity mastery to the level of Beerus's world (never lowers it), so you can land there without being crushed.
textos.Sobe bem devagar, e o seu poder base tra: Rises very slowly, and your base power caps the mastery: up to ×{0} at Super Saiyan level, up to ×{1} at Super Saiyan 2 level, and only near Super Saiyan 3 does it reach 100% (×{2}).
textos.Solta o ceu desta zona: o clima volta a: Releases this zone's sky: the weather goes back to being rolled by the world clock.
textos.Solta o corpo: o seu poder cai ao mínimo: Lets your body go slack: your power drops to the minimum, no one can sense your energy anymore (not even a scouter) and stamina recovers as fast as it possibly can. You become truly weak: you hit and get hit like someone with no power. You can't do it while furious.
textos.Solta o foco: o estudo volta a adiantar: Drops the focus: study goes back to advancing a little of EVERYTHING the person you study knows better than you, instead of ten times as much in just one.
Makes you vanish from everyone's sight (and reappear).
textos.Some da vista. Drena Ki o tempo todo e c: Makes you vanish from sight. Drains Ki the whole time and drops on its own when your Ki runs out -- being invisible is expensive, and it's expensive precisely so it never becomes anyone's default state.
textos.Sorvete... já provaram sorvete? Gelado e: Ice cream... have you ever tried ice cream? Cold and sweet at the same time. A remarkable invention.
textos.Sr. Kaioh ajeita os óculos: \"Um coração: King Kai adjusts his glasses: "A pure heart AND real strength... very well! I'll teach you my ultimate technique: the KAIO-KEN! Use it wisely -- it's your own body that pays the price!"
textos.Sr. Kaioh ri: \"Você ainda está vivo! Nã: King Kai laughs: "You're still alive! You can't train on my planet until you kick the bucket. ...Wanna hear a joke while you're here?"
textos.Sr. Kaioh sorri, solene: \"O seu coração: King Kai smiles solemnly: "Your heart shines without a single shadow... You are worthy of the SPIRIT BOMB! Raise your hands and borrow the energy of every living thing!"
textos.Sr. Kaioh: \"Bem-vindo ao meu pequeno pl: King Kai: "Welcome to my little planet! The gravity here is ten times Earth's -- train hard and you'll return to life stronger than ever. Careful not to step on Bubbles!"
textos.Sr. Kaioh: \"Mantenha esse coração LIMPO: King Kai: "Keep that heart PURE (karma {0}/{1}) and get strong, and maybe I'll teach you a little something..."
textos.Sr. Kaioh: \"Um coração SEM DEFEITO (kar: King Kai: "A FLAWLESS heart (karma {0}/{1}) could still learn my greatest secret..."
textos.Study, na bancada de pesquisa, é o único: Study, at the research bench, is the only way to gain technology. Each level opens new constructions in the catalog.
textos.Sua Super Esfera #{0} está SEGURA -- a t: Your Super Dragon Ball #{0} is SAFE -- the attempt to take it failed ({1}).
textos.Sua carne elástica remenda tudo que arra: Your elastic flesh mends whatever is torn from it. You are endurance made manifest.
textos.Sua fama em {0} apodrece... o povo sussu: Your reputation on {0} is rotting... the people whisper your name with fear and hatred.
textos.Sua ficha moral: o numero, a faixa, o qu: Your moral record: the number, the band, what raises it, what lowers it, and which ranks it opens or closes.
textos.Sua força vem da meditação e do músculo: Your strength comes from meditation and the muscle that swells with it: a warrior of silence.
Your race or class can't learn this one.
textos.Suas copias atacam quem estiver mais per: Your copies attack whoever is closest to them (except you).
textos.Suas copias atacam quem voce marcou (dup: Your copies attack whoever you've marked (double-click).
Your copies stop where they are.
textos.Suas copias passam a seguir voce (param: Your copies start following you (they stop two tiles away).
textos.Super Esferas perderam o dono: quem as t: The Super Dragon Balls have lost their owner: whoever had them no longer exists.
textos.Super Esferas: posse, disputa e a procur: Super Dragon Balls: ownership, contest and Super Shenron's proxy
textos.Só a larva: você cava e some na terra --: Larva only: you dig in and vanish underground -- no one can see or reach you, and you can't move. Five minutes without coming up and your shell matures. Coming up early resets the count.
textos.Só do androide de ABSORÇÃO. Finca os pés:
ABSORPTION Androids only. Plant your feet and open your collectors: while they're open you CAN'T MOVE, and every ki attack that hits you is swallowed whole -- no damage, turned into energy (6% of your tank per hit, stacking up to your charge cap, the one in the Ki tab).

Press again to close them and move again. Getting knocked out closes them automatically.
textos.Só em dragões de até 2 pedidos: com 3, e: Only on dragons with up to 2 wishes: with 3, it drops off the list.
textos.Só o Corrupted Majin que destravou a For: Only for a Corrupted Majin who has unlocked the Pure Form. The Ki attack you're CHARGING right now (a beam in your hand, a sphere taking shape, a volley in progress) comes out with DOUBLE the power, at no extra Ki -- and the price is HALF your sanity. While Insane, the attack comes out with TRIPLE the power and costs a quarter less Ki. With nothing charging, it does nothing. One-minute recharge.
textos.Só o Guardião da Terra ({0}) -- ou um ad: Only the Earth Guardian ({0}) -- or an administrator -- can let you out.
textos.Só quem ergueu a estátua. Ela passa a va: Only whoever raised the statue. It becomes bound to YOUR current power, and the seven scatter again and go back to sleep, waiting to be reborn.
textos.Só quem fala a LÍNGUA DOS DEUSES despert: Only those who speak the LANGUAGE OF THE GODS can awaken Super Shenron. Those who don't can lend the seven to someone who does -- through the window -- and the wish still belongs to the lender.
textos.Só quem foi designado vilão aprende isto: Only someone appointed as a villain can learn this.
Only if you promise not to pass out.
textos.TEMPO ESGOTADO! Os juizes decidem por po: TIME'S UP! The judges will decide on points...
textos.TRANCADO · abre por outro caminho, não: LOCKED  ·  opens some other way, not with milestones
textos.TRANCADO · invista {0} marco{1} nesta: LOCKED  ·  invest milestones in this tree to open it ({0} more; you've invested {2})
textos.Também dá pra mexer direto na tela: arra: You can also adjust things right on screen: drag the title and edges of the menu (P), the edges of the chat, and the corner of the top panels.
Old technique: replaced by Spirit Bomb.
textos.Teleguiado: o raio acompanha quem você m: Homing: the beam follows whoever you've marked ({0} points)
textos.Tenta sentir a energia da Esmeralda Mest: Tries to sense the energy of the Master Emerald. It no longer exists -- and in the original game the power didn't do anything but say so, either.
Type: {0} (can't be changed once it's done).
textos.Tira ESTE planeta (ou o que esta sob voc: Takes THIS planet (or the one below you, in space) off the dead list -- it exists again, repopulates and accepts landings. From afar, use the "Destroyed planets" card on this tab.
Withdraws everything you've stored in the vault.
textos.Tira quem esta marcado da linha de suces: Removes whoever is marked from Vegeta's line of succession.
textos.Tira recursos do chão, a céu aberto ou e: Pulls resources out of the ground, in the open or in a cave: +{0}/s by hand, +{1} with a Shovel in your inventory, +{2} with a Hand Drill. Moving or acting interrupts it; using it again stops it.
textos.Toca alguém ao seu lado e empurra o temp: Touches someone next to you and pushes their time forward: a short burst of speed, paid for with a slice of the recipient's age.
textos.Todo ataque de ki já sai na direção de q: Every ki attack already fires toward whoever is marked — and then does NOT curve. A homing one turns gently after the target, but only up to {0}° from the heading it left on: anyone who moves far off its path escapes. With no one marked, it flies straight.
textos.Todo mundo do servidor, do mais forte pr: Everyone on the server, from strongest to weakest.
textos.Todos os mortos voltam. Quem morreu de v: All the dead come back. Even this wish leaves out those who died of old age.
textos.Toma conta da fila dos condenados. Ela v: Minds the line of the damned, who are always trying to run off.
textos.Tomar quem como Aprendiz de Kaioshin? (e: Who will you take as Kaioshin Apprentice? (they can still accept or decline)
textos.Tome discipulos de qualquer raca e confi: Take disciples of any race and entrust them with the share of divine knowledge that suits an apprentice: healing, telepathy, observation and the sight of the dead. There is a limit on disciples at once, and the bond ends when you leave the throne.
textos.Trancar a minha porta com a senha: Lock my door with the password
textos.Transfere a sua energia pra quem esta ma: Transfers your energy to whoever is marked or nearby: one percent of your max Ki every fifth of a second, healing a little with each dose. When your energy runs out (or you stop), you PASS OUT. Press again to stop.
textos.Transformar mexe no multiplicador e NÃO:
Transforming changes the multiplier and NOT effective power: the form multiplies both sides of that equation.
What changes effective power is Ki, wounds, weights, gravity and age.

Mastery ONLY grows inside the form, by spending Ki -- it's the one thing in the game you can't buy.
Forms of a divine discipline are the exception: they have no mastery of their own -- using them raises the SKILL's proficiency, and that only grows by fighting.
textos.Trapaça no meu duelo? Fora daqui, os doi: Cheating in my duel? Out of here, both of you.
textos.Traz TODO MUNDO do servidor pra onde voc: Brings EVERYONE on the server to where you are.
textos.Traz de volta a vida um morto que esteja: Brings a dead person at your side back to life and pulls them to where you are. The body comes back whole: severed limbs grow back, and Ki and stamina are full. You have to be alive to use it.
Brings the marked target to you.
textos.Traz um morto de volta e o puxa pra pert: Brings someone back from the dead and pulls them to your side. Those who died of OLD AGE don't come back.
textos.Traz um morto de volta. Nem o Super Shen: Brings someone back from the dead. Not even Super Shenron can undo death by old age.
textos.Treina onde você está, no ritmo de sempr: Train right where you are, at the usual pace. You can leave your character idle — any movement takes you out of training.
textos.Treinar lutando contra o seu mestre rend: Training by fighting your master gives {0}× to {1}× more power per hit while they're stronger than you (the stronger they are, the more) — once you surpass your master, the bonus is gone. Against a fellow student — another of their students — {2}×.
textos.Treinar? Tá. Mas rápido, que a soneca nã: Train? Fine. But make it quick, that nap won't take itself. And don't make me sweat.
textos.Treine 5 minutos no planeta do Sr. Kaioh: Train for 5 minutes on King Kai's planet, under its 10x gravity.
textos.Tres socos secos em quem estiver colado,: Three sharp punches on whoever's up close, and the third one SENDS THEM FLYING. Costs stamina on top of energy, and needs at least one free hand.
textos.Troca o C duplo entre as formas mortais: Switches double-tap C between the mortal and the divine forms: it climbs the chosen family first, and the other one only comes in when the chosen one has no form above you.
textos.Trocar TODO o seu tempo de vida por pode: Trade ALL of your lifespan for absolute power: DOUBLE the greatest power in the game, and ONLY ONE MORE YEAR of life. There's no revive from that death -- only reincarnation.
textos.Tá decidido: eu vou com você!: It's settled: I'm coming with you!
textos.Tô treinando pra quando sair daqui. Um d: I'm training for when I get out of here. One day I will.
textos.UM BEBÊ ESTÁ A CAMINHO: A BABY IS ON THE WAY
textos.UM OVO VAI CHOCAR: AN EGG IS ABOUT TO HATCH
textos.UM VILÃO APARECEU: {0} está espalhando o: A VILLAIN HAS APPEARED: {0} is spreading terror {1}. Whoever defeats them earns karma (+{2}) and reputation with the planet (+{3}). They'll be gone in {4} minutes.
textos.UNBOUND EGO no limite! TODO o seu corpo: UNBOUND EGO at its limit! Your ENTIRE body screams, and the ego answers: pain becomes power -- Ki and stamina restored.
textos.UNMATCHED FEROCITY! Nada te segura: pode: UNMATCHED FEROCITY! Nothing holds you back: full power, no drain and no negative effects for {0} s.
textos.UNRESTRAINED WRATH: a ira toma conta --: UNRESTRAINED WRATH: wrath takes over -- BP +20%, max Ki -20%. You can swallow it back down after 30 s.
textos.UNSTOPPABLE FORCE · sem recuo, -10% de d: UNSTOPPABLE FORCE · no knockback, -10% damage taken · {0}
textos.UNSTOPPABLE FORCE: 30 s sem recuo e apan: UNSTOPPABLE FORCE: 30 s with no knockback and taking 10% less damage.
textos.Ultra Instinto automático ao portar o tí: automatic Ultra Instinct while holding the title (UltraInstinct.dm:99)
textos.Um Frost Demon não tem um corpo: tem vár: A Frost Demon doesn't have one body: it has several. Choose the one for each stage.
textos.Um Humano também chega lá!: A Human can get there too!
textos.Um Saibaman nunca para de crescer. Envel: A Saibaman never stops growing. You age a whole month at once and, in exchange, get a surge of energy of about twice your maximum -- plus a boost of power.
textos.Um ano se passou enquanto você esteve fo: A year has passed while you were away: you're now {0} years old.
textos.Um barril de lixo tóxico. Rompido -- na: A barrel of toxic waste. Once ruptured -- in your hands, or left within a bomb's blast radius -- it releases a cloud that knocks back and poisons anyone nearby.
textos.Um bilhão de zeni -- quatro vezes a riqu: A billion zeni -- four times the riches of the Black Star Dragon Balls. Goes to the BENEFICIARY, if there is one.
textos.Um bloco de notas eletrônico. Também con: An electronic notepad. It can also view the cameras on its frequencies, and publish and print books from the global library.
textos.Um cargo tem UM dono no mundo (o Kaioshi: A rank has ONE holder in the world (Kaioshin has five seats), and a soul holds ONE rank. The Kai ladder is the exception: moving up gives up the previous rank.
textos.Um chute de baixo pra cima, com dano ext: An upward kick with extra damage. Cheap, fast, and the bread and butter of anyone who fights with their legs.
textos.Um chute pra baixo. Se o alvo estiver VO: A downward kick. If the target is FLYING, you follow up with a second hit that brings them down to the ground with you. Miss, and you're the one who loses balance.
textos.Um chá quentinho e uns biscoitos cairiam: Some nice hot tea and a few cookies would go down very well while watching this.
textos.Um console de comunicação: assentado no: A communication console: once set on the ground, it sends messages to anyone listening on its frequencies (watches, scouters, other communicators) and stores what it receives.
textos.Um corte curto que vale muito mais quand: A short slash that's worth much more when the target ISN'T IN COMBAT YET. Against someone already fighting, it's just an ordinary, expensive hit. Puts your special attacks on hold for two and a half seconds.
textos.Um de cada vez, e inteiro. Desfaça essa: One at a time, and in one piece. Undo that fusion and come back.
textos.Um de cada vez, por favor. Estou no meio: One at a time, please. I'm in the middle of a lesson.
textos.Um dia do jogo dura {0} minutos; o mês t: A game day lasts {0} minutes; a month has {1} days and a year, {2} months. Age moves with the calendar -- and faster in the Time Chamber.
One of these days I'll learn to fly.
textos.Um dia eu ainda luto no torneio do Outro: Someday I'll fight in the Other World Tournament.
textos.Um disco de corte com dano fixo e ALTO,: A cutting disc with fixed, HIGH damage that chases your marked target for two whole minutes. It doesn't fizzle out like other shots: either it hits, or it slams into something.
textos.Um disco de energia rapido que NAO DA PR: A fast disc of energy that CAN'T BE DEFLECTED and PARALYZES whoever it hits. The damage is next to nothing -- what it does is take the enemy's legs out from under them for up to ten seconds.
textos.Um fio de energia com CINCO vezes a pote: A thread of energy with FIVE times the potency of an ordinary beam and a range of ten tiles. It's the close-range killing technique: no beam in the game packs so much damage into so little distance.
textos.Um giro com a espada de Ki que corta TOD: A spinning slash of your Ki sword that cuts EVERYONE in front of you at once, dealing damage to each of them. Only works with Ki Sword active, and puts your special attacks on hold for a second and a half.
textos.Um golpe curto que deixa energia presa n: A short strike that leaves energy trapped in the target's body: they lose health in the targeted limb right away and again a second and a half later, no roll involved.
textos.Um golpe pesado que deixa o alvo dois se: A heavy blow that leaves the target unable to react for two seconds and CRACKS the ground in a radius equal to your strength.
textos.Um golpe raro de sorte fez de você uma e: A rare stroke of luck made you an elite among the Herans, with exceptional gifts.
textos.Um grito de energia que ARREMESSA quem e: A shout of energy that HURLS whoever is in front of you, with no shot to dodge. If no one is in the way, the gust becomes a blade of air that keeps going.
textos.Um livro em branco: escreva o que quiser: A blank book: write whatever you want in it, and whoever holds it can read it.
textos.Um livro escrito por alguem que chegou a: A book written by someone who reached level {0} in {1}. It only teaches those who already know {2} and are still at level {3} or below -- and it vanishes once read.
textos.Um minuto de ataques de ki infundidos de: One minute of Hakai-infused ki attacks: they pierce deeper, the target defends at half strength, and in a beam struggle yours DEVOURS your rival's every 5s.
textos.Um mortal sem ki divino querendo o MEU t: A mortal without God Ki wants MY title? Come back when your power tastes like a god's.
textos.Ohoho, sem o ki divino desperto não há o: Ohoho, without awakened God Ki there is nothing I can teach you. Come back once it awakens.
textos.Treinar um mortal sem ki divino? Despert: Train a mortal without God Ki? Awaken the ki of the gods first, and then I'll think about it.
The dead can't entrust Dragon Balls to anyone.
A destroyed world comes back into existence.
textos.Um pedido com 100% da força do set -- a: One wish at 100% of the set's strength -- the strength is your BP at the moment you raise the statue.
A raw fish, pulled from the water with a rod. Satisfies hunger.
textos.Um poder colossal e mal contido dorme no: A colossal, barely contained power slumbers in your blood. Even your own kind would tremble before what you might become.
textos.Um potencial imenso e escondido dorme em: An immense hidden potential sleeps within you, waiting for the moment it is unlocked.
textos.Um punho carregado de energia que ECOA:: An energy-charged fist that ECHOES: three waves of damage spread across the target's whole body, one every two seconds, after the hit.
textos.Um quarto do que ainda cabe no seu teto: A quarter of the headroom left under your training cap. The set's CREATOR can't wish for it.
textos.Um raio CURTO e grosso, de cinco tiles,: A SHORT, thick beam, five tiles long, that costs almost nothing per second: its price drops as your Ki skill rises. It's the weapon of close-range fighters who can't stop to charge an expensive beam.
textos.Um raio LARGO, com o dobro do poder do s: A WIDE beam with twice your own body's power behind it and four times the potency of an ordinary beam. It costs fifteen times more Ki per second than an ordinary beam and travels slowly: whoever charges this is betting everything on one shot.
textos.Um raio que sai FORTE e vai MORRENDO no: A beam that starts out STRONG and FADES along the way: every tile it travels takes away some of its power. It's the weapon of close-range fighters -- from afar it arrives weak.
textos.Um relógio que só teleporta: leva você a: A watch that only teleports: it takes you to bolted-down telepads and to other watches on the SAME channel, two seconds after you activate it. It can also talk on the channel.
textos.Um ritual por dia (tempo real); interrom: One ritual per day (real time); if it's interrupted before the end, the day isn't spent. During the ritual this button interrupts it -- and whoever receives the ritual sees it too.
textos.Um salmão cru: o peixe de quem domina a: A raw salmon: the catch of a master angler. The most filling of the three.
textos.Um soco carregado de espírito, que sai c: A spirit-charged punch that comes out as a guaranteed CRITICAL hit. It's paid for with STAMINA, not Ki -- and it locks your normal attacks for a few seconds.
textos.Um soco e um jab na cara, e o alvo e ARR: A punch and a jab to the face, and the target is SENT FLYING forward. If the first hit doesn't land, you're the one who loses balance.
textos.Um tiro de dedo que não se deflete: mira: A finger blast that can't be deflected: it aims at the TORSO, and wherever it wounds it BREAKS the target's guard. Charges in a third of the time of a regular blast. Costs {0} Ki (times your drain).
textos.Um tiro que quase nao machuca e que NAO: A shot that barely hurts and CAN'T BE DEFLECTED: it locks the legs of whoever it hits for five to ten seconds. The target can still fight and defend -- they just can't run anymore. Costs a fortune in Ki.
textos.Um tiro só: paralisa quem acerta e derru: A single shot: it paralyzes whoever it hits, and instantly drops anyone already nearly down (or too weak). It doesn't wound. Reloading and reinforcing are priced by your tech cap.
textos.Um tratado que vale 100 x (sua tecnologi: A treatise worth 100 x (your tech level)² of study.
textos.Um tratado que vale {0} x (sua tecnologi: A treatise worth {0} x (your tech level)² of study.
A single uppercut with huge bonus damage. It's the most expensive move in boxing and the only one that bets everything on a single read -- if they block, it's over.
textos.Um vírus: {0}. É permanente, só se toma: A virus: {0}. It's permanent and can only be taken once -- and taking any virus risks a mutation.
textos.Uma EXECUÇÃO: você crava a cauda em algu:
An EXECUTION: you sink your tail into someone next to you who is KNOCKED OUT and alive, and drink them for 5 seconds, standing still -- moving, falling or them getting up cancels it. The victim SHRIVELS UP, dies and vanishes, leaving no corpse.

You recover 20% of your health, stamina and Ki, and gain their power -- but it's AVERAGED with yours, not added: absorbing is for catching up, not for training.

And that's how you EVOLVE: each player is worth one milestone, and an NPC one fifth; five milestones per form, and the sixth takes you up a form -- semi-perfect, then PERFECT. An infinite-energy Android jumps straight to the next form; an absorption Android is a machine inside and can't be drained. The larva doesn't have the organs for it.

While GRABBING someone, absorb turns into a STAB: the tail pierces one limb at a time -- left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg, head and finally the torso -- and restores 5% of your torso, Ki and stamina. One per second.
textos.Uma Esfera de Estrela Negra -- APAGADA:: A Black Star Dragon Ball -- INERT: stone until the dragon's year has passed.
textos.Uma armadura recém-fabricada, ainda sem: A freshly made suit of armor, still unshaped. Choose its look so you can wear it: once shaped, it protects the body against physical attacks (it makes a difference for beginners).
textos.Uma armadura. Protege o corpo contra gol: A suit of armor. Protects the body against physical attacks -- it makes a difference for beginners, and none for a very strong warrior. Only one at a time.
A bullet of spirit fired from your finger. It DOESN'T use energy: it uses STAMINA -- which is why it still works when your Ki is gone. Training the Spirit tree makes it cheaper and stronger at the same time.
textos.Uma barra vai e volta. Aperte espaço qua: A bar sweeps back and forth. Press Space when the marker crosses the zone. Each hit raises your meditation gains, up to double; a miss drops the bonus and costs stamina.
textos.Uma barragem de socos num alvo so: ate d: A barrage of punches on a single target: up to ten hits in a row, one every two tenths of a second. How many land depends on your Technique. If the target backs off or raises their guard, the barrage stops midway.
textos.Uma bola vazia: aponte pra uma criatura: An empty ball: point it at a knocked-out creature in front of you, and it stores the creature's form, name and power.
textos.Uma caixa de munição enche o pente intei: One box of ammo fully refills a gunpowder weapon's magazine. Blasters don't use it.
textos.Uma casca de Ki que soma defesa fisica E: A shell of Ki that adds physical AND Ki defense while it's up. It drops when you're knocked out or meditate.
textos.Uma casca que soma defesa de Ki E armadu: A shell that adds Ki defense AND energy armor -- the armor is what soaks up shots without taking from your health. It consumes energy every second and drops on its own when the armor runs out.
textos.Uma chave em quem esta agarrado: tira qu: A lock on whoever you're grabbing: takes fifteen points off their struggle to escape and leaves them unable to react for FIVE seconds.
textos.Uma corrida longa terminada num golpe pe: A long dash that ends in a heavy blow -- it reaches MUCH farther than Dropkick and costs almost half. The catch is the same: arriving and finding no one leaves you stunned on the spot.
textos.Uma cova cavada a mao, com o que sobrou: A grave dug by hand, with what's left of someone underneath. What's written on it is the epitaph left by whoever buried them.
textos.Uma criatura aterrorizante emergiu na Te: A terrifying creature has emerged on Earth... CELL is hunting the androids!
textos.Uma das sete Esferas do Dragão -- APAGAD: One of the seven Dragon Balls -- INERT: turned to stone until the set restores itself.
One of the seven Dragon Balls.
textos.Uma esfera de energia solta na direcao e: A ball of energy fired in the direction you're facing. It comes out instantly, doesn't root you and costs little -- in return it flies slowly and loses strength against anyone who knows how to defend against Ki.
textos.Uma esfera de pura Destruição que não se: A sphere of pure Destruction that can't be deflected and applies HAKAI to whoever it wounds, by the same two criteria as the grab (torso at {0}% or less, and {1}% weaker than you). Costs {2} Ki (times your drain).
textos.Uma esfera pesada que PERSEGUE o alvo ma: A heavy sphere that CHASES your marked target until it hits or fizzles out. It's expensive and slow, but getting out of the way won't help. With no marked target, it flies straight and you're warned about it.
textos.Uma esfera pesada que voce forma sobre a: A heavy sphere you form above your head over up to four stages of 1.5 s (each one eats another third of the cost), then GUIDE with your own gaze. Press again to release the guidance; pressing a third time while charging fires it immediately. Costs 150x the base drain and roots you in place while it lasts.
textos.Uma explosao de luz que CEGA quem estive: A burst of light that BLINDS anyone looking at you. Anyone with their back to you is unaffected -- that's why it's used face to face, and why looking away is how you escape it. Costs Ki and takes a while to recharge.
textos.Uma muralha de energia com QUATRO vezes: A wall of energy with FOUR times your power behind it, able to overwhelm people stronger than you. The better your beam skill, the farther and stronger it goes -- and the more absurdly expensive it gets.
A rare mutation has made a monster of you. Your raw power dwarfs that of your own kind.
textos.Uma nuvem de bolas que nascem ESPALHADAS: A cloud of balls that form SCATTERED around you and then converge forward. How many come out depends on your blast and volley skills. Expensive, and it puts the whole barrage family on cooldown.
textos.Uma nuvem de esferas que nasce ESPALHADA: A cloud of spheres that forms SCATTERED around you, hangs in the air for a moment and then converges on your marked target from every angle. How many come out depends on your Ki skill and your strength. Needs a target within thirty tiles.
textos.Uma peça de roupa. Vista por cima do que: A piece of clothing. Wear it over what you already have on -- you can wear up to {0} pieces at once.
textos.Uma presenca maligna e ancestral comeca: An ancient evil presence is beginning to awaken... Something terrible will happen in {0} days.
textos.Uma presença que não é deste mundo pouso: A presence not of this world has landed on Earth. BEERUS, the God of Destruction, has come to see for himself who brought down Majin Buu -- and he brought Whis along.
textos.Uma pílula que alimenta um pouco. Nojent: A pill that feeds you a little. Disgusting -- but it gets the job done.
textos.Uma rajada sem fim de esferas pra frente: An endless stream of spheres fired forward, ten per second, for as long as you hold it -- rooted in place. The first one is cheap; each sphere after it costs TEN times more, and the stream stops on its own when your energy can't pay for the next one. Five-second cooldown afterward.
textos.Uma rasteira suja: se o alvo estiver NO: A dirty leg sweep: if the target is ON THE GROUND, they can't react for three seconds and take a little damage to each limb. Against fliers there's no ground to trip on.
textos.Uma resposta atravessada que machuca: o: A cutting comeback that hurts: your marked target takes MENTAL damage, a quarter of a hit, with no way to dodge.
textos.Uma truta crua: só morde pra quem já pes: A raw trout: it only bites for skilled anglers. More filling than a common fish.
textos.seu corpo se torna mais forte após sofre: your body grows stronger after suffering.

textos.VOCÊ TEM {0} MINUTOS PRA SAIR PELA PORTA: YOU HAVE {0} MINUTES TO GET OUT THROUGH THE DOOR. After that, it stops accepting you.

textos.Vale pelo lugar de onde sai: se voce est: It's all about where it comes from: if you're facing THE SAME WAY as the target -- that is, behind them -- the hit crits. Out of combat, it hits even harder. Three-second cooldown afterward.
textos.Vale pra TODO ataque de ki que sai da su: Applies to EVERY ki attack you fire (Ki Wave, energy balls, your own creations). Doesn't change charging, flying or shield effects.

textos.Voce acende o Ki e se lanca contra o alv: You light up your Ki and launch yourself at your marked target from up to thirty-five tiles away, finishing with a shoulder to their chest. It costs almost nothing -- and the stronger and more technical you are, the LESS it costs.
textos.Voce agarra o alvo pelo tronco e o poe n: You grab the target around the waist and put them on the ground. Against someone FLYING it's devastating: it takes away their flight, hits twice and leaves them stunned for three and a half seconds.
textos.Voce avanca ate dez tiles e acerta um go: You rush up to ten tiles and land a blow that leaves the target unable to react for two and a half seconds. The damage isn't the point -- the silence after it is.
textos.Voce bate na propria bunda e todo mundo: You slap your own butt, and everyone nearby who was fighting is left too dumbfounded to react for a second and a half.
textos.Voce concentra a circulacao do proprio K: You concentrate your own Ki circulation: your Ki offense rises, and your spending rises just as much. Those who've trained circulation and buffing gain more on both ends. Press again to turn it off.
textos.Voce crava um dedo no membro mirado e, d: You jab a finger into the targeted limb and, two seconds later, it bursts from the inside: seventy damage plus your strength and your technique, straight to the limb.
textos.Voce empurra de volta o que vem voando n: You push back whatever comes flying your way. For three swings in a row, every shot in front of you that's weaker than you is SENT BACK to whoever fired it -- and becomes yours.
textos.Voce entra em meditacao e, a cada 3,5 s,: You go into meditation and, every 3.5 s, a training orb appears within four tiles of you and drifts for five seconds. PUNCH IT (it gives training gains). Press again, or stop meditating, to end it.
textos.Voce esta HOSPEDANDO: sair derruba o ser: You are HOSTING: leaving shuts down the server for everyone. Click again.
textos.Voce gira e acerta ate TRES pessoas cola: You spin and hit up to THREE people right next to you at once. It doesn't need a marked target and doesn't move you: it's the answer when you're surrounded up close.
textos.Voce nao foi criado em Vegeta. Mandaram: You weren't raised on Planet Vegeta. They sent you away as a baby to a weak world, easy to conquer -- and this is it: Earth. No one expected you to come back.
textos.Voce nao foi criado em {0}. Puseram o be: You weren't raised on {0}. They put your cradle in a space pod and sent the pod off on a course nobody wrote down -- {1} is just where it came to a stop. There was fear in that decision.

textos.Voce se lanca contra o alvo e acerta com: You launch yourself at the target and hit with both feet. The LESS ground you need to cover, the harder it lands. If the target isn't at the end of your run, you crash on your own and end up stunned.
